<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<script>
window.__LS = (function () {
  function memory() {
    var map = {};
    return {
      getItem: function (k) { return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, k) ? map[k] : null; },
      setItem: function (k, v) { map[k] = String(v); },
      removeItem: function (k) { delete map[k]; },
      clear: function () { map = {}; },
      key: function (i) { return Object.keys(map)[i] || null; },
      get length() { return Object.keys(map).length; }
    };
  }
  try {
    var s = window.localStorage;
    s.setItem('__probe', '1'); s.removeItem('__probe');
    return s;
  } catch (e) { return memory(); }
})();
/* Fragment navigation does nothing in a framed document, so the app's route
   lives here instead. The frame's name carries the page to open on. */
window.__hash = (window.name && window.name.charAt(0) === '/') ? '#' + window.name : '#/';
window.__go = function (to) {
  var next = (String(to).charAt(0) === '#') ? String(to) : '#' + String(to);
  if (next === window.__hash) return;
  window.__hash = next;
  try { window.dispatchEvent(new HashChangeEvent('hashchange')); }
  catch (e) { var ev = document.createEvent('Event'); ev.initEvent('hashchange', true, true); window.dispatchEvent(ev); }
  try { window.scrollTo(0, 0); } catch (e) {}
};
/* Leaving the app (log out, the logo on sign-in pages) opens this file's own
   landing route in the outer page, never an in-app copy of a landing page. */
window.__exitToSite = function () { try { window.parent.location.hash = '#/'; } catch (e) {} };

window.__SS = (function () {
  try {
    var s = window.sessionStorage;
    s.setItem('__probe', '1'); s.removeItem('__probe');
    return s;
  } catch (e) { return window.__LS; }
})();
</script>

<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"/>
<title>Lumera — Admin</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<style>
  @font-face{ font-family:'Manrope'; src:url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2'); font-weight:200 800; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; }
  @font-face{ font-family:'Instrument Serif'; src:url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2'); font-weight:400; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; }

  /* Spatial: the same ground, glass and depth as the site and the app. */
  :root{
    color-scheme:dark;
    --ivory:hsl(248 21% 6%); --cream:rgba(255,255,255,.035); --card:rgba(255,255,255,.035); --sand:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    --line:rgba(255,255,255,.09); --line-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    --charcoal:#ECEAF6; --ink:#FAF9FD; --muted:#A9A7C2; --faint:#817F9C;
    --gold:#8E7BFF; --goldd:#B9AEFF; --golddd:#6E6CF6; --amber:#EBC77A;
    --sage:#4ADE9B; --saged:#5EE3A6; --clay:#F5B95C; --clayd:#F6C77F; --berry:#FB7185; --sky:#7CB4FF;
    --lg-glass:rgba(26,24,38,.58); --lg-glass-strong:rgba(22,21,33,.9);
    --lg-edge:rgba(255,255,255,.10); --lg-edge-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.20);
    --lg-rim:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.09), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.012);
    --lg-depth-1:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.30), 0 12px 28px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.62);
    --lg-depth-2:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.24), 0 20px 46px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.68), 0 46px 96px -50px rgba(30,16,74,.72);
    --lg-blur:blur(28px) saturate(150%);
    --lg-sweep:linear-gradient(100deg,#EBC77A 0%,#C6A8FF 46%,#8E7BFF 100%);
    --lg-ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  }
  *{ box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; }
  body{ margin:0; font-family:'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--charcoal); background:var(--ivory);
    background-image:radial-gradient(1100px 600px at 100% -10%, rgba(142,123,255,.16), transparent 60%),
                     radial-gradient(900px 520px at -10% 110%, rgba(110,108,246,.10), transparent 55%);
    background-attachment:fixed; min-height:100vh; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; font-size:14px; }
  h1,h2,h3{ font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.015em; }
  .serif{ font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-.01em; }
  ::selection{ background:rgba(142,123,255,.34); color:#fff; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar{ width:10px; height:10px; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:20px; border:2px solid var(--ivory); }
  :focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--goldd); outline-offset:2px; }
  .sr-only{ position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0 0 0 0); white-space:nowrap; }
  svg.i{ width:16px; height:16px; flex-shrink:0; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }

  /* Shell: a floating glass sidebar beside the content. */
  .app{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:262px minmax(0,1fr); min-height:100vh; }
  .sidebar{ position:sticky; top:12px; height:calc(100vh - 24px); margin:12px 0 12px 12px; padding:16px 12px 18px; overflow-y:auto;
    background:var(--lg-glass); border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); border-radius:22px; box-shadow:var(--lg-rim), var(--lg-depth-2);
    backdrop-filter:var(--lg-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--lg-blur); }
  .brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:4px 8px 16px; }
  .brand img{ width:34px; height:34px; object-fit:contain; }
  .brand .mark{ font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.2em; font-size:14px; }
  .brand .sub{ display:block; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint); font-weight:600; margin-top:2px; }
  .role-chip{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin:0 8px 14px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:99px; background:var(--sand); color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; max-width:calc(100% - 16px); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
  .navg{ display:block; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .navg .label{ font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint); padding:0 10px 6px; font-weight:700; }
  .navi{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:11px; font:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; border:none; background:none; width:100%; text-align:left; transition:background .2s, color .2s; position:relative; }
  .navi:hover:not(:disabled){ background:var(--sand); color:var(--charcoal); }
  .navi.active{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.075); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--lg-rim); }
  .navi.active::before{ content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:22%; bottom:22%; width:3px; border-radius:99px; background:var(--lg-sweep); }
  .navi.disabled{ cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.4; }
  .navi .count{ margin-left:auto; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:99px; background:rgba(251,113,133,.16); color:var(--berry); }
  body:not([data-mode]) [data-only], body[data-mode="server"] [data-only="local"], body[data-mode="local"] [data-only="server"]{ display:none !important; }

  .main{ padding:26px 32px 64px; max-width:1180px; width:100%; min-width:0; }
  .top{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:20px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .live-dot{ width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--sage); display:inline-block; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(74,222,155,.7); }
  .live-dot.warn{ background:var(--clay); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(245,185,92,.7); }
  .live-dot.bad{ background:var(--berry); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(251,113,133,.7); }
  h1.page{ font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif; font-weight:400; font-size:36px; line-height:1.05; margin:0 0 6px; letter-spacing:-.01em; }
  .page-desc{ color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 20px; max-width:680px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; }

  /* Content panels: a lit translucent fill (no blur), raised by depth. */
  .card{ background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045),rgba(255,255,255,.02)); border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); border-radius:20px; padding:18px;
    box-shadow:var(--lg-rim), var(--lg-depth-1); min-width:0; }
  .card + .card{ margin-top:14px; }
  .row{ display:grid; gap:14px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .row.cols-2{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }
  .row.cols-3{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
  .row.cols-4{ grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); }
  .row > .card + .card{ margin-top:0; }
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .app{ grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); }
    .sidebar{ position:relative; top:0; height:auto; margin:12px 12px 0; }
    .main{ padding:18px 16px 48px; }
    .row.cols-2, .row.cols-3, .row.cols-4{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width:520px){ .row.cols-2,.row.cols-3,.row.cols-4{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } h1.page{ font-size:30px; } }
  .eyebrow{ font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--goldd); font-weight:700; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .kpi{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .kpi .v{ font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif; font-size:38px; line-height:1; font-weight:400; color:var(--ink); }
  .kpi .l{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px; }
  .kpi .delta{ font-size:11px; font-weight:600; margin-top:6px; }
  .kpi .delta.up{ color:var(--saged); } .kpi .delta.down{ color:var(--clayd); }
  .bar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin:7px 0; font-size:13px; }
  .bar .lab{ width:170px; color:var(--charcoal); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
  .bar .track{ flex:1; height:8px; border-radius:99px; background:var(--sand); overflow:hidden; }
  .bar .fill{ height:100%; border-radius:99px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8E7BFF,#C6A8FF); transition:width .6s var(--lg-ease); }
  .bar .val{ width:54px; text-align:right; color:var(--muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

  .btn{ border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); border-radius:99px; padding:8px 14px; font:inherit; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; color:var(--charcoal);
    transition:background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s var(--lg-ease), box-shadow .2s; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:var(--lg-rim); white-space:nowrap; }
  .btn:hover:not(:disabled){ background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-color:var(--lg-edge-hi); }
  .btn:active:not(:disabled){ transform:translateY(1px); }
  .btn:disabled{ opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; }
  .btn.gold{ background:var(--lg-sweep); color:#17110A; border:none; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45), 0 10px 26px -14px rgba(198,168,255,.9); }
  .btn.gold:hover:not(:disabled){ filter:brightness(1.06); background:var(--lg-sweep); }
  .btn.danger{ background:transparent; color:var(--berry); border-color:rgba(251,113,133,.32); }
  .btn.danger:hover:not(:disabled){ background:rgba(251,113,133,.08); border-color:rgba(251,113,133,.5); }
  .btn.ghost{ background:transparent; }
  .btn.sm{ padding:5px 10px; font-size:11.5px; }
  input,textarea,select{ font:inherit; font-size:14px; border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); border-radius:12px; padding:9px 12px; width:100%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); color:var(--charcoal); transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
  select option{ background:#16141f; }
  input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{ color:var(--faint); }
  input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{ outline:none; border-color:rgba(185,174,255,.6); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(142,123,255,.16); }
  label.fl{ display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:5px; font-weight:600; }
  .pill{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:99px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; background:var(--sand); color:var(--muted); white-space:nowrap; }
  .pill.draft{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:var(--muted); }
  .pill.live{ background:rgba(74,222,155,.13); color:var(--saged); }
  .pill.unp{ background:rgba(245,185,92,.13); color:var(--clayd); }
  .pill.bad{ background:rgba(251,113,133,.14); color:var(--berry); }
  .pill.gold{ background:rgba(142,123,255,.18); color:var(--goldd); }
  .muted{ color:var(--muted); } .faint{ color:var(--faint); } .tnum{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .upd{ display:flex; gap:14px; padding:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; margin-bottom:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.02); transition:border-color .2s; }
  .upd:hover{ border-color:var(--lg-edge-hi); }
  .upd .ic{ width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(142,123,255,.14); color:var(--goldd); display:grid; place-items:center; flex-shrink:0; font-size:18px; }
  .upd .body{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .upd .ttl{ font-weight:600; font-size:14px; margin:0 0 4px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
  .upd .meta{ font-size:11px; color:var(--faint); display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .upd .desc{ font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin:0; line-height:1.5; overflow-wrap:anywhere; white-space:pre-wrap; }
  .upd .acts{ display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:flex-start; flex-shrink:0; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:flex-end; }
  @media (max-width:640px){ .upd{ flex-wrap:wrap; } .upd .acts{ width:100%; justify-content:flex-start; } }
  .modal-bg{ position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(6,5,12,.62); backdrop-filter:blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px); display:grid; place-items:center; padding:20px; z-index:99; animation:fadeIn .2s; }
  @keyframes fadeIn{ from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1} }
  .modal{ background:var(--lg-glass-strong); border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); border-radius:22px; padding:22px; max-width:520px; width:100%; box-shadow:var(--lg-rim), var(--lg-depth-2); max-height:90vh; overflow-y:auto; }
  .modal h3{ font-size:20px; margin:0 0 6px; }
  .modal .acts{ display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; margin-top:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .gate{ min-height:100vh; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:24px; }
  .gate .card{ max-width:400px; width:100%; padding:30px 28px; background:var(--lg-glass); backdrop-filter:var(--lg-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--lg-blur); box-shadow:var(--lg-rim), var(--lg-depth-2); }
  .gate .logo{ display:block; width:64px; height:64px; margin:0 auto 14px; object-fit:contain; }
  .gate h1{ font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif; font-weight:400; font-size:32px; margin:0 0 6px; text-align:center; }
  .gate .lede{ color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; margin:0 0 18px; text-align:center; line-height:1.55; }
  .gate .field{ margin-bottom:12px; }
  .gate .err{ color:var(--berry); font-size:12.5px; margin:4px 0 0; min-height:1em; }
  .gate .note{ color:var(--faint); font-size:11.5px; margin:16px 0 0; line-height:1.6; }
  .role-founder,.role-admin{ background:rgba(142,123,255,.18); color:var(--goldd); }
  .role-ops{ background:rgba(124,180,255,.16); color:var(--sky); }
  .role-product{ background:rgba(74,222,155,.14); color:var(--saged); }
  .role-research{ background:rgba(245,185,92,.14); color:var(--clayd); }
  .role-beta{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:var(--muted); }
  .empty{ text-align:center; padding:32px 16px; color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; }
  code{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); padding:1px 6px; border-radius:6px; font-size:.9em; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
  .tbl{ overflow-x:auto; }
  table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px; }
  table th{ text-align:left; padding:10px 8px; font-weight:600; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--faint); border-bottom:1px solid var(--lg-edge-hi); white-space:nowrap; }
  table td{ padding:10px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:middle; }
  table tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:none; }
  .seg{ display:inline-flex; gap:0; border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); border-radius:99px; padding:3px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .seg button{ border:none; background:none; border-radius:99px; padding:5px 12px; font:inherit; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; }
  .seg button.on{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--lg-rim); }
  .toolbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .toolbar .grow{ flex:1; min-width:180px; }
  .logo-tile{ width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; overflow:hidden; flex-shrink:0; }
  .logo-tile img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; }
  .logo-tile.mono{ background:rgba(142,123,255,.18); color:var(--goldd); font-weight:700; }
  .donut-wrap{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; }
  .legend{ font-size:12.5px; }
  .legend .li{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin:4px 0; }
  .legend .sw{ width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:3px; }
  .heat{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(24,1fr); gap:3px; }
  .heat .h{ aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:3px; background:var(--sand); }
  .skel{ height:14px; border-radius:8px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04),rgba(255,255,255,.09),rgba(255,255,255,.04)); background-size:200% 100%; animation:sk 1.4s linear infinite; margin:10px 0; }
  @keyframes sk{ to{ background-position:-200% 0; } }
  .toast{ position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:22px; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:120; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:99px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
    background:var(--lg-glass-strong); border:1px solid var(--lg-edge); box-shadow:var(--lg-rim), var(--lg-depth-2); backdrop-filter:var(--lg-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--lg-blur); max-width:calc(100vw - 32px); }
  .toast.bad{ color:var(--berry); }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ *{ animation:none !important; transition:none !important; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="gate" class="gate">
  <div class="card" role="main">
    <img class="logo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Lumera"/>
    <h1>Admin portal</h1>
    <p class="lede" id="gateLede">Checking the connection…</p>

    <!-- Server: sign in with an account that has the admin role. -->
    <form id="gateServer" data-only="server" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); signIn();" autocomplete="on" novalidate>
      <div class="field"><label class="fl" for="gEmail">Email</label>
        <input id="gEmail" type="email" autocomplete="username" required/></div>
      <div class="field"><label class="fl" for="gPass">Password</label>
        <input id="gPass" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required/></div>
      <p class="err" id="gErrS" role="alert"></p>
      <button class="btn gold" id="gBtn" type="submit" style="width:100%; justify-content:center; margin-top:6px;">Sign in</button>
      <p class="note">Only accounts with the admin role can open the portal. Admin roles are granted from this portal or with <code>ADMIN_EMAILS</code> on the server.</p>
    </form>

    <!-- Offline: no server, so a team key unlocks the editors for this browser only. -->
    <form id="gateLocal" data-only="local" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); tryUnlock();" novalidate>
      <div class="field"><label class="fl" for="key">Team key</label>
        <input id="key" type="password" autocomplete="off"/></div>
      <p class="err" id="gerr" role="alert"></p>
      <button class="btn gold" type="submit" style="width:100%; justify-content:center; margin-top:6px;">Unlock</button>
      <p class="note">Offline mode: no Lumera server answered, so changes are saved in this browser only. Run the server to manage members and publish to everyone.</p>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="app" class="app" style="display:none;">
  <aside class="sidebar" aria-label="Admin navigation">
    <div class="brand">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt=""/>
      <span><span class="mark">LUMERA</span><span class="sub">Admin</span></span>
    </div>
    <span class="role-chip" id="roleChip">Role</span>
    <div class="navg">
      <div class="label">Overview</div>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="overview" data-icon="grid">Overview</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="dashboard" data-icon="grid">Dashboard</button>
    </div>
    <div class="navg" data-only="server">
      <div class="label">Members</div>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="users" data-icon="user">Accounts</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="posts" data-icon="chats">Community</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="reports" data-icon="flag">Reports <span class="count" id="repCount" hidden></span></button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="teamfeedback" data-icon="message">Team feedback <span class="count" id="fbCount" hidden></span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="navg" data-only="local">
      <div class="label">Analytics</div>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="insights" data-icon="users">User insights</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="usage" data-icon="bar">Usage reports</button>
    </div>
    <div class="navg">
      <div class="label">Content</div>
      <button class="navi" data-tab="updates" data-icon="megaphone">Product updates</button>
      <button class="navi" data-tab="news" data-icon="news">News feed</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="offers" data-icon="tag">Discounts &amp; offers</button>
      <button class="navi" data-tab="about" data-icon="info">About &amp; team</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="brand" data-icon="palette">Brand &amp; characters</button>
    </div>
    <div class="navg">
      <div class="label">Product</div>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="feedback" data-icon="message">User feedback</button>
      <button class="navi" data-tab="features" data-icon="toggle">Feature flags</button>
      <button class="navi" data-tab="sections" data-icon="layout">Sections &amp; layout</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="companies" data-icon="building">Subscription logos</button>
    </div>
    <div class="navg" data-only="local">
      <div class="label">Research</div>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="trends" data-icon="trend">Trend monitor</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="market" data-icon="globe">Market tracker</button>
    </div>
    <div class="navg">
      <div class="label">Account</div>
      <button class="navi" data-only="local" data-tab="permissions" data-icon="key">Permissions</button>
      <button class="navi" data-only="server" data-tab="audit" data-icon="history">Audit log</button>
      <button class="navi" data-icon="power" onclick="lock()" id="lockBtn">Lock portal</button>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <main class="main" id="main">
    <div class="top">
      <span class="pill" id="statusPill"><span class="live-dot" id="statusDot"></span><span id="statusText">Live</span></span>
      <span class="faint" id="updatedAt" style="font-size:12px;"></span>
      <span style="flex:1"></span>
      <a class="btn ghost" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the app &rarr;</a>
      <button class="btn ghost" data-only="local" onclick="exportData()">Export JSON</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" data-only="local" onclick="seedDemo()">Seed demo data</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" data-only="local" onclick="clearData()">Clear local</button>
    </div>
    <div id="content"></div>
  </main>
</div>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   Roles & access — keys verified by SHA-256 hash (no plaintext)
   ============================================================ */
const ROLE_KEY_HASHES = {
  '6amaKQQaPKpH7vitzjbX5v/iI6FYoKB7qEjyi/fXDrM=' : 'founder',
  'Fum6ZqB3N6zT0RAUd3eoLuHjONjBwfdERpOd90JOuh0=' : 'ops',
  'TfoTznSBnrVDPrbNFclvwLA0rpkdL1lsNqshSLr/WZs=' : 'product',
  'Wuiq/AJhUQYduNVdeCjW7Y6bnIQJm+MmdQl4ZF1AkVg=' : 'research',
};
const ROLES = {
  founder:  { label:'Founder',                badge:'role-founder',  scope:['*'] },
  ops:      { label:'Operations Associate',   badge:'role-ops',      scope:['dashboard','insights','usage','updates','news','about','brand','permissions'] },
  product:  { label:'Product Dev Associate',  badge:'role-product',  scope:['dashboard','feedback','features','sections','updates','about','brand','permissions'] },
  research: { label:'Innovation & Research',  badge:'role-research', scope:['dashboard','trends','market','news','offers','permissions'] },
  beta:     { label:'Beta Tester',            badge:'role-beta',     scope:[] },
  // Server mode: an account with the admin role.
  admin:    { label:'Administrator',          badge:'role-admin',    scope:['*'] },
};
let CURRENT_ROLE = null;
let MODE = null, ME = null, SYS = {};            // MODE is 'server' or 'local' once detected
const SERVER_EMPTY = {};
// Tabs that only make sense with or without the server.
const LOCAL_ONLY = ['dashboard','insights','usage','offers','brand','feedback','trends','market','permissions'];
const SERVER_ONLY = ['overview','users','posts','reports','teamfeedback','companies','audit'];

/* Web Crypto only exists in a secure context, so opening this file from disk
   or inside a frame left crypto.subtle undefined, sha256b64 threw, and every
   key was rejected. This falls back to a plain implementation. */
function sha256Bytes(str){
  const K=[0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2];
  let H=[0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19];
  const bytes=Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(str));
  const bitLen=bytes.length*8;
  bytes.push(0x80);
  while(bytes.length%64!==56) bytes.push(0);
  const hi=Math.floor(bitLen/4294967296), lo=bitLen>>>0;
  bytes.push((hi>>>24)&255,(hi>>>16)&255,(hi>>>8)&255,hi&255,(lo>>>24)&255,(lo>>>16)&255,(lo>>>8)&255,lo&255);
  const rotr=(x,n)=>(x>>>n)|(x<<(32-n));
  for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=64){
    const w=new Array(64);
    for(let t=0;t<16;t++) w[t]=(bytes[i+t*4]<<24)|(bytes[i+t*4+1]<<16)|(bytes[i+t*4+2]<<8)|bytes[i+t*4+3];
    for(let t=16;t<64;t++){
      const s0=rotr(w[t-15],7)^rotr(w[t-15],18)^(w[t-15]>>>3);
      const s1=rotr(w[t-2],17)^rotr(w[t-2],19)^(w[t-2]>>>10);
      w[t]=(w[t-16]+s0+w[t-7]+s1)|0;
    }
    let [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]=H;
    for(let t=0;t<64;t++){
      const S1=rotr(e,6)^rotr(e,11)^rotr(e,25);
      const ch=(e&f)^(~e&g);
      const t1=(h+S1+ch+K[t]+w[t])|0;
      const S0=rotr(a,2)^rotr(a,13)^rotr(a,22);
      const maj=(a&b)^(a&c)^(b&c);
      const t2=(S0+maj)|0;
      h=g; g=f; f=e; e=(d+t1)|0; d=c; c=b; b=a; a=(t1+t2)|0;
    }
    H=[(H[0]+a)|0,(H[1]+b)|0,(H[2]+c)|0,(H[3]+d)|0,(H[4]+e)|0,(H[5]+f)|0,(H[6]+g)|0,(H[7]+h)|0];
  }
  const out=[];
  H.forEach(v=>out.push((v>>>24)&255,(v>>>16)&255,(v>>>8)&255,v&255));
  return out;
}
async function sha256b64(str){
  try{
    if(window.crypto && window.crypto.subtle){
      const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
      return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(buf)));
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, sha256Bytes(str)));
}
function hasAccess(tab){
  if(!CURRENT_ROLE) return false;
  if(MODE === 'server' ? LOCAL_ONLY.includes(tab) : SERVER_ONLY.includes(tab)) return false;
  const scope = ROLES[CURRENT_ROLE].scope;
  if(scope.includes('*')) return true;
  return scope.includes(tab);
}
async function tryUnlock(){
  const k = document.getElementById('key').value.trim();
  let role=null;
  try{ role = ROLE_KEY_HASHES[await sha256b64(k)]; }catch(e){}
  if(!role){ document.getElementById('gerr').textContent = 'That key is not recognised.'; return; }
  document.getElementById('gerr').textContent = '';
  CURRENT_ROLE = role;
  try{ __SS.setItem('lumera_admin_role', role); }catch(e){}
  showApp();
}
function lock(){
  if(MODE === 'server'){
    API.post('/api/auth/logout').catch(()=>{}).then(()=>sessionEnded(''));
    return;
  }
  CURRENT_ROLE = null; clearInterval(DASH_TIMER);
  try{ __SS.removeItem('lumera_admin_role'); }catch(e){}
  document.getElementById('app').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('gate').style.display='grid';
  document.getElementById('key').value='';
}
function showApp(){
  document.getElementById('gate').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('app').style.display='grid';
  const cfg = ROLES[CURRENT_ROLE];
  const chip = document.getElementById('roleChip');
  chip.textContent = (MODE === 'server' && ME) ? `${cfg.label} · ${ME.name}` : cfg.label;
  chip.title = (MODE === 'server' && ME) ? ME.email : '';
  chip.className = 'role-chip ' + cfg.badge;
  document.querySelectorAll('.navi').forEach(b=>{
    const tab = b.getAttribute('data-tab');
    if(!tab){ return; }
    if(!hasAccess(tab)){ b.classList.add('disabled'); b.disabled = true; }
    else { b.classList.remove('disabled'); b.disabled = false; }
    b.onclick = ()=>switchTab(tab);
  });
  const firstTab = MODE === 'server' ? 'overview' : (cfg.scope.includes('*') ? 'dashboard' : (cfg.scope[0]||'dashboard'));
  switchTab(firstTab);
}

let ACTIVE_TAB = null, DASH_TIMER = null;
function switchTab(tab){
  clearInterval(DASH_TIMER); DASH_TIMER = null;
  if(!hasAccess(tab)){
    document.getElementById('content').innerHTML = `<div class="card empty">
      <div style="font-size:30px; margin-bottom:8px;">🔒</div>
      <p><strong>${ROLES[CURRENT_ROLE].label}</strong> doesn&apos;t have access to this section.</p>
      <p class="faint" style="margin-top:6px;">Access for each role is set in <code>ROLES</code> in this file.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  ACTIVE_TAB = tab;
  document.querySelectorAll('.navi').forEach(b=>{ b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-tab')===tab); });
  render();
  setStatus();
  // Live auto-refresh for the analytics views (offline mode reads this browser's storage)
  if(MODE === 'local' && ['dashboard','insights','usage'].includes(tab)) DASH_TIMER = setInterval(()=>{ if(ACTIVE_TAB===tab) render(); }, 3000);
}

/* ============================================================
   Storage + analytics helpers (reads what the Lumera app records)
   ============================================================ */
const ACCT='lumera_accounts', ANALYTICS='lumera_analytics', UPDATES='lumera_updates', NEWS='lumera_news', OFFERS='lumera_offers', FEEDBACK='lumera_feedback', FEATURES='lumera_flags';
const loadJSON = (k, def)=>{ try{ const v=JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(k)); return (v==null)?def:v; }catch(e){ return def; } };
const DAY=864e5;
const LABELS={'/dashboard':'Dashboard','/budget':'Budget','/goals':'Goals','/emergency':'Emergency Fund','/subscriptions':'Subscriptions','/networth':'Net Worth','/simulator':'Wealth Simulator','/twin':'Financial Twin','/invest':'Investing','/market':'Stock Market','/globe':'Global Markets','/world':'World Monitor','/news':'News','/learn':'Learn','/resources':'Knowledge Hub','/badges':'Badges','/updates':"What's New",'/credit':'Credit','/debt':'Debt','/insurance':'Insurance','/retirement':'Retirement','/assistant':'AI Assistant','/hub':'Products','/leaf':'Leaf','/atlas':'Atlas','/shield':'Shield','/forge':'Forge','/':'Landing','/login':'Login','/signup':'Sign up','/onboarding':'Onboarding','/review':'Review','/settings':'Settings'};
const labelOf=p=>LABELS[p]||p||'—';
const langName=c=>({en:'English',ar:'Arabic',ur:'Urdu',hi:'Hindi',fr:'French',es:'Spanish',de:'German'}[c]||c||'—');
const fmtDur=ms=>{ const s=Math.round(ms/1000); if(s<60) return s+'s'; const m=Math.floor(s/60); return m+'m '+(s%60)+'s'; };

function computeAnalytics(){
  const an = loadJSON(ANALYTICS, {sessions:[],events:[]});
  const sessions = an.sessions||[], events = an.events||[];
  const accts = loadJSON(ACCT, {});
  // distinct users = registered accounts ∪ named (non-guest) session users
  const userSet = new Set(Object.keys(accts));
  sessions.forEach(s=>{ if(s.user && s.user!=='guest') userSet.add(s.user); });
  const distinctUsers = userSet.size;
  const logons = sessions.length;                 // each app session = one logon/visit
  const guestSessions = sessions.filter(s=>!s.user || s.user==='guest').length;
  const avgLogons = distinctUsers ? logons/distinctUsers : 0;
  // per-user session counts → new vs returning
  const byUser = {}; sessions.forEach(s=>{ const u=s.user||'guest'; if(u==='guest') return; byUser[u]=(byUser[u]||0)+1; });
  const returningUsers = Object.values(byUser).filter(n=>n>1).length;
  const retentionPct = distinctUsers ? Math.round(returningUsers/distinctUsers*100) : 0;
  // time windows
  const start0=new Date(); start0.setHours(0,0,0,0); const todayMs=start0.getTime();
  const activeToday = sessions.filter(s=>(s.start||0)>=todayMs).length;
  const active7 = new Set(); sessions.forEach(s=>{ if((s.start||0)>=Date.now()-7*DAY && s.user && s.user!=='guest') active7.add(s.user); });
  // duration
  const durs = sessions.map(s=>Math.max(0,(s.end||s.start||0)-(s.start||0)));
  const avgDur = durs.length ? durs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/durs.length : 0;
  // views
  const views = events.filter(e=>e.type==='view');
  const viewsPerSession = sessions.length ? views.length/sessions.length : 0;
  // sessions over last 14 days
  const days=[]; for(let i=13;i>=0;i--){ const d=new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); d.setDate(d.getDate()-i); const a=d.getTime(); days.push({t:a, n:sessions.filter(s=>(s.start||0)>=a && (s.start||0)<a+DAY).length}); }
  // peak hours
  const hours=new Array(24).fill(0); sessions.forEach(s=>{ if(s.start) hours[new Date(s.start).getHours()]++; });
  // feature usage (views by route)
  const feat={}; views.forEach(v=>{ const k=labelOf(v.path); feat[k]=(feat[k]||0)+1; });
  // breakdowns
  const langs={}, currs={}; sessions.forEach(s=>{ const l=s.lang||'en', c=s.cur||'—'; langs[l]=(langs[l]||0)+1; currs[c]=(currs[c]||0)+1; });
  return { sessions, events, accts, distinctUsers, logons, guestSessions, avgLogons, returningUsers, retentionPct,
    activeToday, active7:active7.size, avgDur, views, viewsPerSession, days, hours, feat, langs, currs };
}

const C = document.getElementById('content');
function escapeHtml(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c])); }
function pageHead(title, desc){ return `<h1 class="page">${title}</h1><p class="page-desc">${desc}</p>`; }
function kpi(eyebrow, value, label, delta){ return `<div class="card kpi"><div class="eyebrow">${eyebrow}</div><div class="v tnum">${value}</div><div class="l">${label||''}</div>${delta||''}</div>`; }
function barRows(obj, fmt){ const ent=Object.entries(obj).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]); const max=Math.max(1,...ent.map(e=>e[1]));
  return ent.length? ent.map(([k,v])=>`<div class="bar"><div class="lab">${escapeHtml(k)}</div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${Math.round(v/max*100)}%"></div></div><div class="val tnum">${fmt?fmt(v):v}</div></div>`).join('') : '<p class="empty">No data yet.</p>'; }

function sparkline(days){
  const vals=days.map(d=>d.n); const max=Math.max(1,...vals); const w=620,h=150,pl=8,pr=8,pt=18,pb=26,n=vals.length;
  const X=i=>pl+(i/((n-1)||1))*(w-pl-pr);
  const Y=v=>h-pb-(v/max)*(h-pb-pt);
  const line=vals.map((v,i)=>`${i?'L':'M'}${X(i).toFixed(1)},${Y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  const area=`M${X(0)},${h-pb} `+vals.map((v,i)=>`L${X(i).toFixed(1)},${Y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')+` L${X(n-1)},${h-pb} Z`;
  const labs=days.map((d,i)=> (i%2===0)? `<text x="${X(i)}" y="${h-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#9EA0B6">${new Date(d.t).toLocaleDateString([], {day:'numeric',month:'short'})}</text>`:'').join('');
  const dots=vals.map((v,i)=>`<circle cx="${X(i)}" cy="${Y(v)}" r="3" fill="#8B5CF6"/>`).join('');
  const nums=vals.map((v,i)=> v? `<text x="${X(i)}" y="${Y(v)-7}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#E9EAF4">${v}</text>`:'').join('');
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" style="width:100%;height:auto" font-family="inherit">
    <path d="${area}" fill="rgba(139,92,246,.14)"/>
    <path d="${line}" fill="none" stroke="#A78BFA" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    ${dots}${nums}${labs}</svg>`;
}
function donut(obj, colors){
  const ent=Object.entries(obj).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,6); const total=Math.max(1,ent.reduce((a,e)=>a+e[1],0));
  let acc=0; const R=52, Cx=60, Cy=60, SW=18;
  const segs=ent.map(([k,v],i)=>{ const frac=v/total; const a0=acc*2*Math.PI-Math.PI/2; acc+=frac; const a1=acc*2*Math.PI-Math.PI/2;
    const x0=Cx+R*Math.cos(a0), y0=Cy+R*Math.sin(a0), x1=Cx+R*Math.cos(a1), y1=Cy+R*Math.sin(a1); const large=frac>.5?1:0;
    return `<path d="M${x0.toFixed(1)},${y0.toFixed(1)} A${R},${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${x1.toFixed(1)},${y1.toFixed(1)}" fill="none" stroke="${colors[i%colors.length]}" stroke-width="${SW}"/>`;
  }).join('');
  const legend=ent.map(([k,v],i)=>`<div class="li"><span class="sw" style="background:${colors[i%colors.length]}"></span>${escapeHtml(k)} <span class="faint tnum" style="margin-left:auto">${Math.round(v/total*100)}%</span></div>`).join('');
  return `<div class="donut-wrap"><svg width="120" height="120" viewBox="0 0 120 120">${segs}<circle cx="60" cy="60" r="${R-SW/2}" fill="none"/></svg><div class="legend" style="flex:1">${legend||'<span class="faint">No data.</span>'}</div></div>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   Render router
   ============================================================ */
function render(){
  if(!ACTIVE_TAB) return;
  ({ dashboard:renderDashboard, insights:renderInsights, usage:renderUsage, updates:renderUpdates, news:renderNews,
     offers:renderOffers, feedback:renderFeedback, features:renderFeatures, trends:renderTrends, market:renderMarket,
     about:renderAbout, brand:renderBrand, sections:renderSections, permissions:renderPermissions,
     overview:renderOverview, users:renderUsers, posts:renderPosts, reports:renderReports, teamfeedback:renderTeamFeedback, companies:renderCompanies, audit:renderAudit }[ACTIVE_TAB]
   || (MODE === 'server' ? renderOverview : renderDashboard))();
  document.getElementById('updatedAt').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`;
}

function renderDashboard(){
  const A=computeAnalytics();
  const updates = loadJSON(UPDATES, []);
  const published = updates.filter(u=>u.status==='published').length;
  const drafts = updates.filter(u=>u.status==='draft').length;
  C.innerHTML = `
    ${pageHead('Admin overview', `Welcome back, ${ROLES[CURRENT_ROLE].label}. Live snapshot — refreshes every 3 seconds.`)}
    <div class="row cols-4">
      ${kpi('Distinct users', A.distinctUsers, 'Unique people')}
      ${kpi('Total logons', A.logons, 'Sessions / visits')}
      ${kpi('Avg logons / user', A.avgLogons.toFixed(1), 'Visits per person')}
      ${kpi('Active today', A.activeToday, 'Sessions since midnight')}
    </div>
    <div class="row cols-4">
      ${kpi('Returning users', A.returningUsers, A.retentionPct+'% of users return')}
      ${kpi('Page views', A.views.length, A.viewsPerSession.toFixed(1)+' per session')}
      ${kpi('Avg session', fmtDur(A.avgDur), 'Time on site')}
      ${kpi('Active · 7 days', A.active7, 'Weekly active users')}
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="eyebrow">Sessions · last 14 days</div>
      ${A.logons? sparkline(A.days) : '<p class="empty">No sessions captured yet. Use Lumera in this browser/origin to populate live data — or click “Seed demo data”.</p>'}
    </div>
    <div class="row cols-2">
      <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Most-used features</div>${barRows(A.feat)}</div>
      <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Recent updates</div>
        ${updates.slice(0,3).map(u=>`<div class="upd"><div class="ic">📝</div><div class="body">
          <h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(u.title)}</h3>
          <div class="meta"><span class="pill ${u.status==='published'?'live':'draft'}">${u.status}</span><span>${escapeHtml(u.date)}</span></div>
          <p class="desc">${escapeHtml((u.body||'').slice(0,120))}${(u.body||'').length>120?'…':''}</p></div></div>`).join('') || '<p class="empty">No updates yet.</p>'}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Quick actions</div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:6px;">
        ${hasAccess('insights') ? `<button class="btn gold" onclick="switchTab('insights')">Open user insights</button>`:''}
        ${hasAccess('updates') ? '<button class="btn" onclick="newUpdate()">+ New update</button>' : ''}
        ${hasAccess('news')    ? '<button class="btn" onclick="newNews()">+ News headline</button>' : ''}
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

function renderInsights(){
  const A=computeAnalytics();
  const recent = A.sessions.slice(-14).reverse();
  const peakMax=Math.max(1,...A.hours);
  const goldRamp=['#8B5CF6','#A78BFA','#60A5FA','#34D399','#FBBF24','#FB7185'];
  C.innerHTML = `
    ${pageHead('User insights', 'Who is using Lumera, how often, and how deeply — computed live from real sessions on this origin.')}
    <div class="row cols-4">
      ${kpi('Distinct users', A.distinctUsers, 'Unique people')}
      ${kpi('Total logons', A.logons, 'All sessions')}
      ${kpi('Avg logons / user', A.avgLogons.toFixed(1), 'Loyalty')}
      ${kpi('Return rate', A.retentionPct+'%', A.returningUsers+' came back')}
    </div>
    <div class="row cols-4">
      ${kpi('Active today', A.activeToday, 'Sessions')}
      ${kpi('Weekly active', A.active7, 'Users · 7 days')}
      ${kpi('Avg session', fmtDur(A.avgDur), A.viewsPerSession.toFixed(1)+' views/session')}
      ${kpi('Guest visits', A.guestSessions, 'Not signed in')}
    </div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Sessions · last 14 days</div>${A.logons? sparkline(A.days):'<p class="empty">No sessions yet.</p>'}</div>
    <div class="row cols-2">
      <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">By language</div>${donut(A.langs, goldRamp)}</div>
      <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">By currency</div>${donut(A.currs, goldRamp)}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Active hours (sessions by hour of day)</div>
      <div class="heat" style="margin-top:8px">${A.hours.map(v=>`<div class="h" title="${v} sessions" style="background:rgba(139,92,246,${(v/peakMax*0.85+0.06).toFixed(2)})"></div>`).join('')}</div>
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:4px"><span>12am</span><span>6am</span><span>12pm</span><span>6pm</span><span>11pm</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Recent sessions</div>
      ${recent.length? `<table><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>User</th><th>Views</th><th>Duration</th><th>Lang · Cur</th></tr></thead><tbody>
        ${recent.map(s=>`<tr><td class="faint">${new Date(s.start||Date.now()).toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${escapeHtml(s.user||'guest')}</td><td class="tnum">${s.views||0}</td>
          <td class="tnum">${fmtDur(Math.max(0,(s.end||s.start||0)-(s.start||0)))}</td>
          <td class="faint">${langName(s.lang)} · ${escapeHtml(s.cur||'—')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`
        : '<p class="empty">No sessions yet.</p>'}
    </div>`;
}

function renderUsage(){
  const A=computeAnalytics();
  const routeViews={}; A.views.forEach(v=>{ const k=labelOf(v.path); routeViews[k]=(routeViews[k]||0)+1; });
  const sorted=Object.entries(routeViews).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  C.innerHTML = `
    ${pageHead('Usage reports', 'Page-by-page activity across this origin, refreshing live.')}
    <div class="row cols-3">
      ${kpi('Total sessions', A.logons)}
      ${kpi('Total page views', A.views.length)}
      ${kpi('Distinct routes', sorted.length)}
    </div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Top pages</div>
      ${sorted.length? barRows(routeViews) : '<p class="empty">No view events yet. Use Lumera in the same browser to populate these (or click “Seed demo data”).</p>'}
    </div>`;
}

/* ===== Content management (updates / news / offers / feedback / flags) ===== */
// Mirrors UPDATES_SEED in Lumera.html: what members see until updates are published here.
const UPDATES_SEED = [
  { id:'u1', date:'May 2026', tag:'Live now', status:'published', title:'Live currency conversion + 10 currencies', body:'Switch display currency and every value recalculates at live exchange rates, with country flags.', published_at:0 },
  { id:'u2', date:'May 2026', tag:'Live now', status:'published', title:'7 languages with auto-translation', body:'Interface and dynamic text translate across English, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, French, Spanish and German.', published_at:0 },
  { id:'u3', date:'Nov 2026', tag:'Live now', status:'published', title:'Password reset by email, and a safer sign-in', body:'Reset your own password from the login page, and every account is protected by rate limits and encrypted storage.', published_at:0 },
  { id:'u4', date:'Jun 2026', tag:'Live now', status:'published', title:'Streak rewards and custom entries', body:'Daily check-in rewards, plus your own budget categories and subscriptions.', published_at:0 },
  { id:'u5', date:'Next', tag:'Coming', status:'published', title:'Leaf, Atlas, Shield and Forge', body:'Four new worlds for learning, markets, protection and careers. They open one at a time.', published_at:0 },
];
(function migrateUpdates(){ let arr=loadJSON(UPDATES,null); if(!Array.isArray(arr)||arr.length===0){ saveJSON(UPDATES, UPDATES_SEED); } })();

function renderUpdates(){
  const list = loadJSON(UPDATES, []);
  const groups={ draft:[], published:[], archived:[] }; list.forEach(u=>(groups[u.status]||groups.published).push(u));
  C.innerHTML = `
    ${pageHead('Product updates', 'Edit, publish or archive changelog entries. Published items appear on What&rsquo;s New in Lumera; publishing asks for confirmation.')}
    ${MODE === 'server' && SERVER_EMPTY.updates ? `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;"><p class="muted" style="margin:0;font-size:13px;">Members currently see the app&rsquo;s built-in list, shown below. Your first change saves this list to the server.</p></div>` : ''}
    <div class="card"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">
      <div><div class="eyebrow">Update library</div><span class="faint" style="font-size:12px;">${groups.published.length} published · ${groups.draft.length} draft · ${groups.archived.length} archived</span></div>
      <button class="btn gold" onclick="newUpdate()">+ New update</button></div></div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Drafts (${groups.draft.length})</div>${groups.draft.map(updateRow).join('')||'<p class="empty">No drafts.</p>'}</div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Published (${groups.published.length})</div>${groups.published.map(updateRow).join('')||'<p class="empty">No published updates yet.</p>'}</div>
    ${groups.archived.length?`<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Archived (${groups.archived.length})</div>${groups.archived.map(updateRow).join('')}</div>`:''}`;
}
function updateRow(u){
  const pill=u.status==='published'?'<span class="pill live">Published</span>':u.status==='draft'?'<span class="pill draft">Draft</span>':'<span class="pill unp">Archived</span>';
  return `<div class="upd"><div class="ic">📝</div><div class="body">
    <h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(u.title)||'<span class="faint">(untitled)</span>'}</h3>
    <div class="meta">${pill}<span>${escapeHtml(u.date)}</span>${u.published_at?`<span class="faint">${new Date(u.published_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>`:''}</div>
    <p class="desc">${escapeHtml((u.body||'').slice(0,200))}${(u.body||'').length>200?'…':''}</p></div>
    <div class="acts"><button class="btn sm" onclick="editUpdate('${u.id}')">Edit</button>
      ${u.status!=='published'?`<button class="btn sm gold" onclick="askPublish('${u.id}')">Publish</button>`:''}
      ${u.status==='published'?`<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="setStatus('${u.id}','draft')">Unpublish</button>`:''}
      <button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteUpdate('${u.id}')">Delete</button></div></div>`;
}
function newUpdate(){ const list=loadJSON(UPDATES,[]); const u={id:'u'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8), date:new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{month:'short',year:'numeric'}), tag:'Coming', status:'draft', title:'', body:'', published_at:0}; list.unshift(u); saveJSON(UPDATES,list); switchTab('updates'); editUpdate(u.id); }
function editUpdate(id){ const u=loadJSON(UPDATES,[]).find(x=>x.id===id); if(!u) return;
  document.body.appendChild(mkModal(`<h3>${u.title?'Edit update':'New update'}</h3>
    <p class="muted" style="font-size:13px;margin:0 0 14px;">Saves to draft. Publish from the row when ready.</p>
    <label class="fl">Title</label><input id="md_title" value="${escapeHtml(u.title)}"/>
    <div style="height:10px"></div><label class="fl">Date label</label><input id="md_date" value="${escapeHtml(u.date)}"/>
    <div style="height:10px"></div><label class="fl">Tag</label><select id="md_tag">${['Live now','Coming','Shipped'].map(t=>`<option ${u.tag===t?'selected':''}>${t}</option>`).join('')}</select>
    <div style="height:10px"></div><label class="fl">Body</label><textarea id="md_body" rows="5">${escapeHtml(u.body)}</textarea>
    <div class="acts"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button><button class="btn gold" onclick="saveEdit('${u.id}')">Save</button></div>`));
  setTimeout(()=>{ const t=document.getElementById('md_title'); if(t) t.focus(); },50); }
function saveEdit(id){ const list=loadJSON(UPDATES,[]); const i=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===id); if(i<0) return;
  list[i].title=document.getElementById('md_title').value.trim(); list[i].date=document.getElementById('md_date').value.trim();
  list[i].tag=document.getElementById('md_tag').value; list[i].body=document.getElementById('md_body').value.trim();
  saveJSON(UPDATES,list); broadcast('lumera_updates'); closeModal(); render(); }
function askPublish(id){ const u=loadJSON(UPDATES,[]).find(x=>x.id===id); if(!u) return; if(!u.title){ alert('Add a title before publishing.'); editUpdate(id); return; }
  document.body.appendChild(mkModal(`<h3>Publish this update?</h3>
    <p class="muted" style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 6px;">${MODE === 'server' ? 'Members see it on What&rsquo;s New the next time they open Lumera.' : 'Offline mode: it appears in the app in this browser only.'}</p>
    <div style="background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin:14px 0;">
      <div style="font-weight:600">${escapeHtml(u.title)}</div><div class="faint" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:3px">${escapeHtml(u.date)} · ${escapeHtml(u.tag)}</div></div>
    <div class="acts"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="btn gold" onclick="doPublish('${u.id}')">Confirm &amp; publish</button></div>`)); }
function doPublish(id){ setStatus(id,'published',Date.now()); closeModal(); }
function setStatus(id,status,ts){ const list=loadJSON(UPDATES,[]); const i=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===id); if(i<0) return; list[i].status=status; if(status==='published') list[i].published_at=ts||Date.now(); saveJSON(UPDATES,list); broadcast('lumera_updates'); render(); }
function deleteUpdate(id){ if(!confirm('Permanently delete this update?')) return; saveJSON(UPDATES, loadJSON(UPDATES,[]).filter(x=>x.id!==id)); broadcast('lumera_updates'); render(); }

function renderNews(){ const list=loadJSON(NEWS,[]);
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('News feed','Headlines that appear in Lumera under /news. Custom rows surface above the seeded feed.')}
    <div class="card"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">
      <div class="eyebrow">Custom headlines (${list.length})</div><button class="btn gold" onclick="newNews()">+ Add headline</button></div></div>
    <div class="card">${list.length===0?'<p class="empty">No custom headlines yet — Lumera uses the seeded feed.</p>':list.map((n,i)=>`
      <div class="upd"><div class="ic">📰</div><div class="body"><h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(n.title)}</h3>
        <div class="meta"><span class="pill gold">${escapeHtml(n.cat||'Markets')}</span><span>${escapeHtml(n.source||'Lumera')}</span><span class="faint">${escapeHtml(n.date||'')}</span></div>
        <p class="desc">${escapeHtml(n.body||n.summary||'')}</p></div>
      <div class="acts"><button class="btn sm" onclick="editNews(${i})">Edit</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="delNews(${i})">Delete</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`; }
function newNews(){ const list=loadJSON(NEWS,[]); list.unshift({title:'',body:'',cat:'Markets',source:'Lumera',date:new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{month:'short',year:'numeric'}),url:''}); saveJSON(NEWS,list); switchTab('news'); editNews(0); }
function editNews(i){ const list=loadJSON(NEWS,[]); const n=list[i]; if(!n) return;
  document.body.appendChild(mkModal(`<h3>Edit news headline</h3>
    <label class="fl">Title</label><input id="n_title" value="${escapeHtml(n.title)}"/><div style="height:8px"></div>
    <label class="fl">Category</label><select id="n_cat">${['Markets','Economy','Rates','Saving'].map(c=>`<option ${n.cat===c?'selected':''}>${c}</option>`).join('')}</select><div style="height:8px"></div>
    <label class="fl">Source</label><input id="n_source" value="${escapeHtml(n.source||'')}"/><div style="height:8px"></div>
    <label class="fl">Date label</label><input id="n_date" value="${escapeHtml(n.date||'')}"/><div style="height:8px"></div>
    <label class="fl">URL</label><input id="n_url" value="${escapeHtml(n.url||'')}"/><div style="height:8px"></div>
    <label class="fl">Body</label><textarea id="n_body" rows="4">${escapeHtml(n.body||n.summary||'')}</textarea>
    <div class="acts"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="btn gold" onclick="saveNews(${i})">Save</button></div>`)); }
function saveNews(i){ const list=loadJSON(NEWS,[]); const n=list[i]; if(!n) return;
  n.title=document.getElementById('n_title').value.trim(); n.cat=document.getElementById('n_cat').value; n.source=document.getElementById('n_source').value.trim();
  n.date=document.getElementById('n_date').value.trim(); n.url=document.getElementById('n_url').value.trim(); n.body=document.getElementById('n_body').value.trim();
  saveJSON(NEWS,list); broadcast('lumera_news'); closeModal(); render(); }
function delNews(i){ if(!confirm('Delete this headline?')) return; const list=loadJSON(NEWS,[]); list.splice(i,1); saveJSON(NEWS,list); broadcast('lumera_news'); render(); }

function renderOffers(){ const list=loadJSON(OFFERS,[]);
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Discounts & offers','Curated offers shown on Lumera /discounts.')}
    <div class="card">${list.length===0?'<p class="empty">No custom offers — Lumera is using the seeded list.</p>':list.map((o,i)=>`
      <div class="upd"><div class="ic">🎁</div><div class="body"><h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(o.title||'(untitled)')}</h3>
        <div class="meta"><span class="pill gold">${escapeHtml(o.category||'—')}</span><span>${escapeHtml(o.provider||'')}</span><span class="faint">${escapeHtml(o.country||'')} · expires ${escapeHtml(o.expires||'')}</span></div>
        <p class="desc">${escapeHtml(o.desc||'')}</p></div><div class="acts"><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="delOffer(${i})">Delete</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Add offers via console</div><p class="muted" style="font-size:13px;">In the Lumera console: <code>__LS.setItem('lumera_offers', JSON.stringify([...]))</code> then reload /discounts.</p></div>`; }
function delOffer(i){ if(!confirm('Delete this offer?')) return; const list=loadJSON(OFFERS,[]); list.splice(i,1); saveJSON(OFFERS,list); broadcast('lumera_offers'); render(); }

function renderFeedback(){ const list=loadJSON(FEEDBACK,[]);
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('User feedback','Feedback submitted in-app surfaces here in real time.')}
    <div class="card">${list.length===0?'<p class="empty">No feedback yet. Wire an in-app feedback button to push to <code>__LS[\'lumera_feedback\']</code>.</p>':list.slice().reverse().map(f=>`
      <div class="upd"><div class="ic">💬</div><div class="body"><h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(f.subject||'Feedback')}</h3>
        <div class="meta"><span>${escapeHtml(f.email||'anonymous')}</span><span class="faint">${new Date(f.at||Date.now()).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
        <p class="desc">${escapeHtml(f.body||'')}</p></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`; }

// Must mirror FEATURES in Lumera.html (same keys, same storage key 'lumera_flags').
const APP_FEATURES=[
  ['community','Community','Member feed, connections and shared opportunities'],
  ['careerLab','CV & LinkedIn Lab','CV templates, best practices and free courses'],
  ['sideIncome','Side Income','Placeholder page, awaiting a live source. Safe to switch off.'],
  ['testCentre','Test Centre','Score tracking, admissions percentiles, SAT calculator and test tips'],
  ['opportunities','Opportunities','Internships, competitions, programmes and scholarships'],
  ['salary','Salary Check','Benchmark pay by role and level'],
  ['universities','Universities','Ranked university shortlist and comparison'],
  ['subjects','Subject Selection','Recommended subjects per career path'],
  ['prep','Career Prep Hub','Skill roadmaps for interviews'],
  ['wordOfDay','Word of the Day','Daily vocabulary with spaced repetition'],
  ['worldMonitor','World Monitor','Interactive global risk map'],
  ['globe','Global Markets','Spinnable globe of exchanges'],
];
// Each feature has three states so you can preview before launching:
//   off   - hidden from everyone
//   beta  - visible only in beta preview (adds ?beta=1 to the app URL)
//   live  - visible to everyone
function featureState(flags,k){ const v=flags[k]; if(v==='beta') return 'beta'; if(v===false||v==='off') return 'off'; return 'live'; }
function renderFeatures(){ const flags=loadJSON(FEATURES,{});
  const st=(k)=>featureState(flags,k);
  const live=APP_FEATURES.filter(f=>st(f[0])==='live').length;
  const beta=APP_FEATURES.filter(f=>st(f[0])==='beta').length;
  const off=APP_FEATURES.filter(f=>st(f[0])==='off').length;
  const chip=(k,val,label,colour)=>`<button onclick="setFlagState('${k}','${val}')"
    style="border:1px solid ${st(k)===val?colour:'var(--line)'};background:${st(k)===val?colour:'transparent'};
    color:${st(k)===val?'#fff':'var(--muted)'};border-radius:99px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">${label}</button>`;
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Feature flags','Stage a rollout without shipping code. Off hides a feature entirely, Beta shows it only in beta preview, Live releases it to everyone.')}
    <div class="row cols-4" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v" style="color:var(--saged)">${live}</div><div class="l">Live</div></div>
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v" style="color:var(--clayd)">${beta}</div><div class="l">In beta</div></div>
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v" style="color:var(--faint)">${off}</div><div class="l">Off</div></div>
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v">${APP_FEATURES.length}</div><div class="l">Total features</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="eyebrow">Beta preview</div>
      <p class="page-desc" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Open the app with beta preview to see everything marked Beta before it goes live. The link works on this origin.</p>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <a class="btn gold" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open beta preview &rarr;</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open live site &rarr;</a>
        <button class="btn ghost" onclick="allBetaLive()">Promote all beta to live</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">${APP_FEATURES.map(([k,label,desc])=>`
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <span style="flex:1;min-width:200px;"><span style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600;">${label}</span>
          <span class="faint" style="display:block;font-size:12px;">${desc}</span></span>
        <span style="display:flex;gap:6px;">${chip(k,'off','Off','#6E6F88')}${chip(k,'beta','Beta','#D97706')}${chip(k,'live','Live','#16A34A')}</span>
      </div>`).join('')}</div>`; }
function setFlagState(k,val){ const flags=loadJSON(FEATURES,{}); flags[k]=(val==='live')?true:(val==='off')?false:'beta';
  saveJSON(FEATURES,flags); broadcast(FEATURES); render(); }
function allBetaLive(){ const flags=loadJSON(FEATURES,{});
  Object.keys(flags).forEach(k=>{ if(flags[k]==='beta') flags[k]=true; });
  saveJSON(FEATURES,flags); broadcast(FEATURES); render(); }
function toggleFlag(k,v){ setFlagState(k, v?'live':'off'); }


/* ============================================================
   SECTIONS & LAYOUT
   Owns the shape of the app's navigation: the order of sections and of
   the pages inside them, whether a section is shown at all, and whether
   a whole world (Leaf, Atlas, Shield, Forge) is switched on.
   Mirrors NAV and SUBS in Lumera.html; written to 'lumera_layout'.
   ============================================================ */
const LAYOUT='lumera_layout';
const WORLDS=[
  ['leaf','Leaf','Learn & grow','#22C55E','Lessons, quizzes, challenges and the knowledge hub'],
  ['atlas','Atlas','Markets & investing','#3B82F6','Investing, markets, exchanges, the globe and news'],
  ['shield','Shield','Protect & plan','#64748B','Credit, debt, insurance and retirement'],
  ['forge','Forge','Career & income','#C0873A','Careers, firms, universities, tests, prep and salary'],
];
// Must mirror NAV in Lumera.html (same section names, same routes).
const APP_NAV=[
  ['Overview',[['/dashboard','Dashboard'],['/twin','Financial Twin'],['/simulator','Wealth Simulator']]],
  ['Money',[['/budget','Budget'],['/goals','Goals'],['/emergency','Emergency Fund'],['/subscriptions','Subscriptions'],['/debt','Debt'],['/networth','Net Worth'],['/retirement','Retirement']]],
  ['Optimise',[['/insurance','Insurance'],['/credit','Credit']]],
  ['Markets',[['/invest','Investing'],['/market','Markets'],['/globe','Global Markets'],['/world','World Monitor'],['/news','News']]],
  ['Grow',[['/learn','Learn'],['/resources','Knowledge Hub'],['/badges','Badges'],['/updates','Updates'],['/pricing','Pricing'],['/privacy','Privacy']]],
];
// Which world each route belongs to, so a world toggle can grey out its pages.
const ROUTE_WORLD={};
[['leaf',['/learn','/quiz','/challenges','/resources']],
 ['atlas',['/invest','/market','/exchanges','/globe','/world','/news']],
 ['shield',['/credit','/debt','/insurance','/retirement']],
 ['forge',['/careers','/firms','/universities','/tests','/subjects','/finance-vs-econ','/prep','/career-lab','/opportunities','/sideincome','/salary']]
].forEach(([k,rs])=>rs.forEach(r=>{ ROUTE_WORLD[r]=k; }));

const NAV_LABEL={}; APP_NAV.forEach(([,items])=>items.forEach(([to,label])=>{ NAV_LABEL[to]=label; }));

// Every page that lives inside a world, so any of them can be moved into the
// main Lumera menu. Must mirror SUBS in Lumera.html.
const WORLD_PAGES=[
  ['/learn','Learn','leaf'],['/quiz','Money Quiz','leaf'],['/challenges','Challenges','leaf'],['/resources','Knowledge Hub','leaf'],
  ['/invest','Investing','atlas'],['/market','Markets','atlas'],['/exchanges','How Markets Work','atlas'],['/globe','Global Markets','atlas'],['/world','World Monitor','atlas'],['/news','News','atlas'],
  ['/credit','Credit','shield'],['/debt','Debt','shield'],['/insurance','Insurance','shield'],['/retirement','Retirement','shield'],
  ['/careers','Finance Careers','forge'],['/firms','Top Finance Firms','forge'],['/universities','Universities','forge'],['/tests','Test Centre','forge'],
  ['/subjects','Subject Selection','forge'],['/finance-vs-econ','Finance vs Economics','forge'],['/prep','Career Prep Hub','forge'],
  ['/career-lab','CV & LinkedIn Lab','forge'],['/opportunities','Opportunities','forge'],['/sideincome','Side Income','forge'],['/salary','Salary Check','forge'],
];
function setMoved(route,on){ const L=getLayout(); const m=new Set(L.moved||[]); if(on) m.add(route); else m.delete(route); L.moved=[...m]; putLayout(L); }
function defaultLayout(){
  return { worlds:WORLDS.reduce((o,w)=>{ o[w[0]]=true; return o; },{}),
           sections:APP_NAV.map(([name,items])=>({ name, on:true, items:items.map(i=>i[0]) })), moved:[] };
}

/* Saved layout merged over the defaults, so a page added in code still appears. */
function getLayout(){
  const def=defaultLayout(); const saved=loadJSON(LAYOUT,null);
  if(!saved || typeof saved!=='object') return def;
  const worlds={}; WORLDS.forEach(w=>{ worlds[w[0]] = (saved.worlds && w[0] in saved.worlds) ? !!saved.worlds[w[0]] : true; });
  const known={}; def.sections.forEach(sec=>{ known[sec.name]=sec; });
  const seenSec={}, seenItem={}; const sections=[];
  (Array.isArray(saved.sections)?saved.sections:[]).forEach(sec=>{
    if(!sec || !known[sec.name] || seenSec[sec.name]) return;
    seenSec[sec.name]=1;
    const valid=known[sec.name].items;
    const items=(Array.isArray(sec.items)?sec.items:[]).filter(r=> valid.includes(r) && !seenItem[r] && (seenItem[r]=1));
    sections.push({ name:sec.name, on:sec.on!==false, items });
  });
  def.sections.forEach(sec=>{
    const existing=sections.find(x=>x.name===sec.name);
    const missing=sec.items.filter(r=>!seenItem[r]);
    if(existing) existing.items=existing.items.concat(missing);
    else if(!seenSec[sec.name]) sections.push({ name:sec.name, on:true, items:missing.length?missing:sec.items.slice() });
    missing.forEach(r=>{ seenItem[r]=1; });
  });
  const moved=(Array.isArray(saved.moved)?saved.moved:[]).filter(r=>WORLD_PAGES.some(p=>p[0]===r));
  const launched={}; WORLDS.forEach(w=>{ launched[w[0]] = !!(saved.launched && saved.launched[w[0]]); });
  return { worlds, sections, moved, launched };
}

function putLayout(l){ saveJSON(LAYOUT,l); broadcast(LAYOUT); render(); }

function renderSections(){
  const L=getLayout();
  const worldsOff=WORLDS.filter(w=>!L.worlds[w[0]]).length;
  const secsOff=L.sections.filter(s=>!s.on).length;
  const pages=L.sections.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.items.length,0);

  const worldCard=([k,name,tag,colour,desc])=>{
    const on=L.worlds[k]!==false; const live=!!(L.launched&&L.launched[k]);
    return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <span style="width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;
        background:${colour}22;color:${colour};">${name[0]}</span>
      <span style="flex:1;min-width:200px;">
        <span style="font-size:14px;font-weight:600;">${escapeHtml(name)}</span>
        <span class="faint" style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-left:8px;">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>
        <span class="faint" style="display:block;font-size:12px;">${escapeHtml(desc)}</span></span>
      <span style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
        <button onclick="setLaunched('${k}',${!live})" title="${live?'Launched: members can use it':'Not launched: members see Coming soon'}" style="border:1px solid ${live?'#D97706':'var(--line)'};background:${live?'#D97706':'transparent'};color:${live?'#fff':'var(--muted)'};border-radius:99px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">${live?'Launched':'Coming soon'}</button>
        <button onclick="setWorld('${k}',false)" style="border:1px solid ${!on?'#6E6F88':'var(--line)'};background:${!on?'#6E6F88':'transparent'};color:${!on?'#fff':'var(--muted)'};border-radius:99px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Off</button>
        <button onclick="setWorld('${k}',true)" style="border:1px solid ${on?'#16A34A':'var(--line)'};background:${on?'#16A34A':'transparent'};color:${on?'#fff':'var(--muted)'};border-radius:99px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">On</button>
      </span></div>`;
  };

  const sectionCard=(sec,si)=>{
    const rows=sec.items.map((to,ii)=>{
      const w=ROUTE_WORLD[to];
      const dimmed = w && L.worlds[w]===false;
      return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);opacity:${dimmed?.45:1};">
        <span style="flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13px;">${escapeHtml(NAV_LABEL[to]||to)}
          <span class="faint" style="font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;">${escapeHtml(to)}</span>
          ${dimmed?`<span class="faint" style="font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;">${escapeHtml(w)} is off</span>`:''}</span>
        <button class="btn ghost" style="padding:2px 8px;" onclick="moveItem(${si},${ii},-1)" ${ii===0?'disabled':''}>&uarr;</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" style="padding:2px 8px;" onclick="moveItem(${si},${ii},1)" ${ii===sec.items.length-1?'disabled':''}>&darr;</button>
      </div>`;
    }).join('') || '<p class="empty">No pages in this section.</p>';

    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:12px;opacity:${sec.on?1:.6};">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;">
        <span style="flex:1;min-width:160px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;">${escapeHtml(sec.name)}
          <span class="faint" style="font-weight:400;font-size:12px;margin-left:8px;">${sec.items.length} page${sec.items.length===1?'':'s'}</span></span>
        <button class="btn ghost" style="padding:3px 10px;" onclick="moveSection(${si},-1)" ${si===0?'disabled':''}>&uarr; Up</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" style="padding:3px 10px;" onclick="moveSection(${si},1)" ${si===L.sections.length-1?'disabled':''}>&darr; Down</button>
        <button class="btn ${sec.on?'ghost':'gold'}" style="padding:3px 10px;" onclick="toggleSection(${si})">${sec.on?'Hide section':'Show section'}</button>
      </div>
      ${rows}</div>`;
  };

  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Sections & layout', MODE==='server'
    ? 'Rearrange the navigation and switch whole worlds off. Saved to the server; members get the new layout the next time they open Lumera.'
    : 'Rearrange the navigation and switch whole worlds off. Offline mode: changes apply to the app in this browser only.')}
    <div class="row cols-4" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v">${L.sections.length - secsOff}</div><div class="l">Sections shown</div></div>
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v" style="color:var(--faint)">${secsOff}</div><div class="l">Sections hidden</div></div>
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v" style="color:var(--saged)">${WORLDS.length - worldsOff}</div><div class="l">Worlds on</div></div>
      <div class="card kpi"><div class="v">${pages}</div><div class="l">Pages arranged</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="eyebrow">Worlds</div>
      <p class="page-desc" style="margin-bottom:6px;">Switching a world off removes it from the family grid, the sidebar and the landing page, and closes its pages by URL as well.</p>
      ${WORLDS.map(worldCard).join('')}
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="eyebrow">Move world pages into Lumera</div>
      <p class="page-desc" style="margin-bottom:8px;">A moved page appears in the main Lumera menu, opens in the Lumera look, and leaves its world's menu. It stays reachable even if its world is switched off.</p>
      ${WORLDS.map(([wk,wname,,colour])=>`<div style="margin-top:12px;"><div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:${colour};margin-bottom:6px;">${escapeHtml(wname)}</div>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">${WORLD_PAGES.filter(p=>p[2]===wk).map(([r,label])=>{ const on=(L.moved||[]).includes(r);
          return `<button class="btn sm ${on?'gold':'ghost'}" onclick="setMoved('${r}',${!on})" aria-pressed="${on}">${on?'✓ In Lumera':'Move to Lumera'} · ${escapeHtml(label)}</button>`; }).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">
      <span style="flex:1;min-width:200px;font-size:13px;" class="faint">Move sections and pages with the arrows. The app reads this order live.</span>
      <a class="btn ghost" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the app &rarr;</a>
      <button class="btn ghost" onclick="resetLayout()">Reset to default order</button>
    </div>

    ${L.sections.map(sectionCard).join('')}`;
}

function setWorld(k,on){ const L=getLayout(); L.worlds[k]=!!on; putLayout(L); }
// Launching a world opens its tools to every member. Until then its pages show "Coming soon".
function setLaunched(k,on){ if(on && !confirm('Launch this world for every member? Its pages stop showing "Coming soon".')) return;
  const L=getLayout(); L.launched=L.launched||{}; L.launched[k]=!!on; putLayout(L); }
function toggleSection(si){ const L=getLayout(); if(!L.sections[si]) return; L.sections[si].on=!L.sections[si].on; putLayout(L); }
function moveSection(si,dir){ const L=getLayout(); const j=si+dir;
  if(j<0 || j>=L.sections.length) return;
  const [row]=L.sections.splice(si,1); L.sections.splice(j,0,row); putLayout(L); }
function moveItem(si,ii,dir){ const L=getLayout(); const sec=L.sections[si]; if(!sec) return;
  const j=ii+dir; if(j<0 || j>=sec.items.length) return;
  const [row]=sec.items.splice(ii,1); sec.items.splice(j,0,row); putLayout(L); }
function resetLayout(){ if(!confirm('Reset every section, page order and world switch to the default?')) return;
  putLayout(defaultLayout()); }

function renderTrends(){ const news=loadJSON(NEWS,[]),updates=loadJSON(UPDATES,[]);
  const text=[...news.map(n=>n.title+' '+(n.body||n.summary||'')),...updates.map(u=>u.title+' '+u.body)].join(' ').toLowerCase();
  const stop=new Set('a an the and or but for of to in on at by with from as is are was were be been being have has had do does did will would can could should may might must this that these those it its we our you your i my they their lumera live new now'.split(' '));
  const words=(text.match(/[a-z]{4,}/g)||[]).filter(w=>!stop.has(w)); const freq={}; words.forEach(w=>freq[w]=(freq[w]||0)+1);
  const top=Object.entries(freq).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,25);
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Trend monitor','Top concepts emerging across published content, news and updates.')}
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Term frequency</div>${top.length===0?'<p class="empty">Not enough content to compute trends yet.</p>':top.map(([w,n])=>{const pct=Math.round(n/top[0][1]*100);return `<div class="bar"><div class="lab">${w}</div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div><div class="val tnum">${n}</div></div>`;}).join('')}</div>`; }

function renderMarket(){
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Market tracker','Quick-links into the live external dashboards Lumera surfaces.')}
    <div class="row cols-2">${[['Reuters Markets','https://www.reuters.com/markets/'],['Bloomberg Markets','https://www.bloomberg.com/markets'],['FRED','https://fred.stlouisfed.org/'],['Trading Economics','https://tradingeconomics.com/'],['CFR Conflict Tracker','https://www.cfr.org/global-conflict-tracker'],['Freightos FBX','https://fbx.freightos.com/'],['MarineTraffic','https://www.marinetraffic.com/'],['Zoom Earth','https://zoom.earth/']].map(([n,u])=>`<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">${escapeHtml(n)}</div><a class="btn" href="${u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open ↗</a></div>`).join('')}</div>`; }

function renderPermissions(){ const tabs=['dashboard','insights','usage','updates','news','offers','about','brand','feedback','features','trends','market','permissions'];
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Permissions','Matrix of which role can access which section. Founder-only edits.')}
    <div class="card" style="overflow-x:auto;"><table><thead><tr><th>Section</th>${Object.values(ROLES).map(r=>`<th style="text-align:center;">${r.label}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>${tabs.map(tab=>`<tr><td style="font-weight:500;">${tab}</td>${Object.values(ROLES).map(r=>{const has=r.scope.includes('*')||r.scope.includes(tab);return `<td style="text-align:center;">${has?'<span style="color:var(--saged);font-size:18px;">✓</span>':'<span style="color:var(--faint);">·</span>'}</td>`;}).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>
    <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Role keys</div><p class="muted" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;">Each role unlocks with a distinct key (verified by SHA-256 hash). Replace a hash in <code>ROLE_KEY_HASHES</code> to change a key. <strong>Beta Testers</strong> have no access; that role exists for scope completeness only.</p></div>`; }

/* ============================================================
   Modals + utilities
   ============================================================ */
function mkModal(html){ closeModal(); const wrap=document.createElement('div'); wrap.className='modal-bg'; wrap.id='modal'; wrap.onclick=e=>{ if(e.target===wrap) closeModal(); };
  wrap.innerHTML=`<div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">${html}</div>`;
  MODAL_RETURN=document.activeElement;
  setTimeout(()=>{ const f=wrap.querySelector('input:not([readonly]),textarea,select,button.gold,button.danger'); if(f) f.focus(); },40);
  return wrap; }
let MODAL_RETURN=null;
document.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='Escape' && document.getElementById('modal')) closeModal(); });
