function getAbout(){ const a=loadJSON(ABOUT,{})||{}; if(!Array.isArray(a.team)||!a.team.length) a.team=TEAM_SEED.slice(); return a; }
function putAbout(a){ saveJSON(ABOUT,a); broadcast(ABOUT); }
function renderAbout(){ const a=getAbout();
  const field=(id,label,val,ph)=>`<label class="fl">${label}</label><input id="${id}" value="${escapeHtml(val||'')}" placeholder="${escapeHtml(ph||'')}"/><div style="height:10px"></div>`;
  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('About &amp; team','Edit the public About and Team pages. Changes appear in the app straight away — leave a field blank to fall back to the built-in copy.')}
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="eyebrow">About page</div>
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      ${field('ab_title','Headline',a.aboutTitle,'Built to make financial clarity accessible to everyone.')}
      <label class="fl">Standfirst</label><textarea id="ab_desc" rows="2" placeholder="One or two sentences under the headline.">${escapeHtml(a.aboutDesc||'')}</textarea>
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <label class="fl">Mission statement</label><textarea id="ab_mission" rows="3">${escapeHtml(a.mission||'')}</textarea>
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      ${field('ab_teamEyebrow','Team page eyebrow',a.teamEyebrow,'Our team')}
      ${field('ab_teamTitle','Team page headline',a.teamTitle,'The people building Lumera.')}
      <label class="fl">Team page standfirst</label><textarea id="ab_teamDesc" rows="2">${escapeHtml(a.teamDesc||'')}</textarea>
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      ${field('ab_joinTitle','Join-us heading',a.joinTitle,'Want to join us?')}
      ${field('ab_joinDesc','Join-us text',a.joinDesc,'We are always happy to hear from people who care about this problem.')}
      ${field('ab_email','Contact email',a.email,'hello@lumera.app')}
      <div class="acts" style="margin-top:4px;"><button class="btn gold" onclick="saveAboutCopy()">Save about copy</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
        <div><div class="eyebrow">Founding team</div>
        <p class="page-desc" style="margin:2px 0 0;">${a.team.length} people. ${MODE === 'server' ? 'Photos are resized and saved with the page content.' : 'Photos are resized and stored in this browser.'}</p></div>
        <button class="btn ghost" style="margin-left:auto" onclick="addMember()">+ Add person</button>
      </div>
      <div style="height:12px"></div>
      <div class="row cols-3">${a.team.map((p,i)=>memberCard(p,i)).join('')}</div>
    </div>`;
}
function memberCard(p,i){
  return `<div class="card" style="padding:14px;">
    <div style="aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;">
      ${p.photo?`<img src="${escapeHtml(p.photo)}" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;"/>`
               :`<span class="faint" style="font-size:12px;">No photo yet</span>`}
    </div>
    <label class="fl">Name</label><input id="tm_name_${i}" value="${escapeHtml(p.name||'')}"/>
    <div style="height:8px"></div><label class="fl">Title</label><input id="tm_role_${i}" value="${escapeHtml(p.role||'')}" placeholder="Add role"/>
    <div style="height:8px"></div><label class="fl">Focus (optional)</label><input id="tm_focus_${i}" value="${escapeHtml(p.focus||'')}"/>
    <div style="height:8px"></div><label class="fl">Short description</label><textarea id="tm_bio_${i}" rows="3" placeholder="A sentence or two.">${escapeHtml(p.bio||'')}</textarea>
    <div style="height:8px"></div><label class="fl">LinkedIn URL</label><input id="tm_li_${i}" value="${escapeHtml(p.li||'')}" placeholder="https://linkedin.com/in/..."/>
    <div style="height:10px"></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;">
      <input type="file" accept="image/*" id="tm_file_${i}" style="display:none" onchange="uploadPhoto(${i},this)"/>
      <button class="btn ghost" onclick="document.getElementById('tm_file_${i}').click()">Upload photo</button>
      ${p.photo?`<button class="btn ghost" onclick="clearPhoto(${i})">Remove photo</button>`:''}
      <button class="btn gold" style="margin-left:auto" onclick="saveMember(${i})">Save</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" onclick="removeMember(${i})">Delete</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function saveAboutCopy(){ const a=getAbout();
  const g=(id)=>{ const el=document.getElementById(id); return el?el.value.trim():''; };
  a.aboutTitle=g('ab_title'); a.aboutDesc=g('ab_desc'); a.mission=g('ab_mission');
  a.teamEyebrow=g('ab_teamEyebrow'); a.teamTitle=g('ab_teamTitle'); a.teamDesc=g('ab_teamDesc');
  a.joinTitle=g('ab_joinTitle'); a.joinDesc=g('ab_joinDesc'); a.email=g('ab_email');
  putAbout(a); render(); }
function readMember(a,i){ const g=(f)=>{ const el=document.getElementById('tm_'+f+'_'+i); return el?el.value.trim():undefined; };
  const p=a.team[i]; ['name','role','focus','bio','li'].forEach(f=>{ const v=g(f); if(v!==undefined) p[f]=v; }); }
function saveMember(i){ const a=getAbout(); readMember(a,i); putAbout(a); render(); }
function addMember(){ const a=getAbout(); a.team.forEach((_,i)=>readMember(a,i));
  a.team.push({name:'New person', role:'Add role', focus:'', photo:null, bio:'', li:''}); putAbout(a); render(); }
function removeMember(i){ const a=getAbout(); if(!confirm(`Remove ${a.team[i].name} from the team page?`)) return;
  a.team.splice(i,1); putAbout(a); render(); }
function clearPhoto(i){ const a=getAbout(); readMember(a,i); a.team[i].photo=null; putAbout(a); render(); }
function uploadPhoto(i,input){ const f=input.files&&input.files[0]; if(!f) return;
  if(!/^image\//.test(f.type)){ toast('Choose an image file.', true); input.value=''; return; }
  if(f.size>15e6){ toast('That image is over 15 MB. Choose a smaller one.', true); input.value=''; return; }
  shrinkImage(f, 640).then(url=>{ const a=getAbout(); readMember(a,i); a.team[i].photo=url; putAbout(a); render(); })
    .catch(e=>toast(e.message, true)); }

// Must match srcKey() in the app so the uploaded slot is found at render time.
const srcKey=(name)=>String(name).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'').slice(0,32);
function srcCard(a,name,tag){
  const k='src_'+srcKey(name); const src=a[k];
  return `<div class="card" style="padding:12px;">
    <div style="aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;overflow:hidden;
      background:var(--cream);border:${src?'1px solid var(--line)':'2px dashed var(--line)'};">
      ${src?`<img src="${escapeHtml(src)}" alt="" style="max-width:80%;max-height:80%;object-fit:contain;"/>`
           :`<span class="faint" style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700;">${escapeHtml(name.trim()[0])}</span>`}
    </div>
    <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;">${escapeHtml(name)}</div>
    <div class="faint" style="font-size:10.5px;margin:2px 0 8px;">${escapeHtml(tag)}</div>
    <input type="file" accept="image/*" id="as_${k}" style="display:none" onchange="uploadAsset('${k}',this)"/>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
      <button class="btn ghost" style="flex:1;font-size:11.5px;padding:6px 8px;" onclick="document.getElementById('as_${k}').click()">${src?'Replace':'Upload'}</button>
      ${src?`<button class="btn ghost" style="font-size:11.5px;padding:6px 8px;" onclick="clearAsset('${k}')">&times;</button>`:''}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

    </div>

function getAssets(){ return loadJSON(ASSETS,{})||{}; }
function putAssets(a){ saveJSON(ASSETS,a); broadcast(ASSETS); }
function renderBrand(){ const a=getAssets();

  C.innerHTML=`${pageHead('Brand &amp; characters','Upload the logo and the five character illustrations. They replace the built-in drawings everywhere in the app the moment you save. Transparent PNGs look best; anything not uploaded keeps its fallback drawing.')}

      Square images with transparent backgrounds sit best in the app: the coloured tiles behind each character come from the product theme,
      so art with its own solid background will show as a block.</p>

function assetCard(a,k,label,hint){
  const tint=ASSET_TINT[k]||'#8B5CF6'; const src=a[k];
  return `<div class="card" style="padding:14px;">
    <div style="aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;
      background:linear-gradient(140deg,${tint}22,${tint}08);border:${src?`1px solid var(--line)`:`2px dashed ${tint}77`};">
      ${src?`<img src="${escapeHtml(src)}" alt="" style="max-width:88%;max-height:88%;object-fit:contain;"/>`
           :`<div style="text-align:center;padding:12px;">
               <div style="font-size:26px;opacity:.5;">🖼️</div>
               <div class="faint" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:6px;">Placeholder</div></div>`}
    </div>
    <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;">${escapeHtml(label)}</div>
    <p class="faint" style="font-size:11.5px;margin:4px 0 10px;line-height:1.5;">${escapeHtml(hint)}</p>
    <input type="file" accept="image/*" id="as_${k}" style="display:none" onchange="uploadAsset('${k}',this)"/>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
      <button class="btn gold" style="flex:1" onclick="document.getElementById('as_${k}').click()">${src?'Replace':'Upload'}</button>
      ${src?`<button class="btn ghost" onclick="clearAsset('${k}')">Remove</button>`:''}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function uploadAsset(k,input){ const f=input.files&&input.files[0]; if(!f) return;
  if(f.size>600000){ alert('That image is '+Math.round(f.size/1024)+' KB. Please use one under 600 KB — artwork is stored in this browser.'); input.value=''; return; }
  const r=new FileReader();
  r.onload=()=>{ const a=getAssets(); a[k]=r.result; putAssets(a); render(); };
  r.readAsDataURL(f); }
function clearAsset(k){ const a=getAssets(); delete a[k]; putAssets(a); render(); }

function closeModal(){ const m=document.getElementById('modal'); if(m){ m.remove(); if(MODAL_RETURN && document.contains(MODAL_RETURN)) try{ MODAL_RETURN.focus(); }catch(e){} MODAL_RETURN=null; } }
function broadcast(ch){ try{ const bc=new BroadcastChannel(ch); bc.postMessage({}); bc.close(); }catch(e){} }
// Live sync: when Lumera writes analytics, refresh the open analytics view.
try{ const bc=new BroadcastChannel('lumera_analytics'); bc.onmessage=()=>{ if(['dashboard','insights','usage'].includes(ACTIVE_TAB)) render(); }; }catch(e){}

function exportData(){
  const A=computeAnalytics();
  const data={ role:CURRENT_ROLE, generated:new Date().toISOString(),
    summary:{ distinctUsers:A.distinctUsers, totalLogons:A.logons, avgLogonsPerUser:+A.avgLogons.toFixed(2), returnRatePct:A.retentionPct, activeToday:A.activeToday, weeklyActive:A.active7, avgSessionMs:Math.round(A.avgDur), pageViews:A.views.length },
    analytics:loadJSON(ANALYTICS,{}), accounts:Object.keys(loadJSON(ACCT,{})), updates:loadJSON(UPDATES,[]), news:loadJSON(NEWS,[]), offers:loadJSON(OFFERS,[]), feedback:loadJSON(FEEDBACK,[]), features:loadJSON(FEATURES,{}) };
  const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}); const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download=`lumera-admin-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
function clearData(){ if(!confirm('Clear all locally-stored analytics, news, offers, updates, feedback, features? Cannot be undone.')) return;
  [ANALYTICS,NEWS,OFFERS,FEEDBACK,FEATURES].forEach(k=>__LS.removeItem(k)); saveJSON(UPDATES,UPDATES_SEED);
  broadcast('lumera_updates'); broadcast('lumera_news'); broadcast('lumera_offers'); render(); }

// Generate realistic demo analytics so the dashboard is populated for a walkthrough.
function seedDemo(){
  if(!confirm('Add ~40 demo sessions/users to local analytics so you can see the dashboard populated? (Does not affect real data shape.)')) return;
  const an=loadJSON(ANALYTICS,{sessions:[],events:[]});
  const langs=['en','en','en','ar','fr','es','hi'], curs=['USD','AED','GBP','EUR','INR'];
  const routes=['/dashboard','/budget','/invest','/market','/learn','/goals','/subscriptions','/leaf','/atlas','/news','/credit','/simulator'];
  const users=[]; for(let i=0;i<18;i++) users.push('user'+(i+1)+'@demo.app');
  for(let s=0;s<42;s++){
    const start=Date.now()-Math.floor(Math.random()*13)*DAY-Math.floor(Math.random()*86400000);
    const dur=60000+Math.floor(Math.random()*900000);
    const user=Math.random()<0.78? users[Math.floor(Math.random()*users.length)] : 'guest';
    const lang=langs[Math.floor(Math.random()*langs.length)], cur=curs[Math.floor(Math.random()*curs.length)];
    const id='s'+start.toString(36)+s; const nViews=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
    an.sessions.push({ id, start, end:start+dur, views:nViews, lang, cur, user });
    for(let v=0; v<nViews; v++){ an.events.push({ ts:start+v*30000, type:'view', path:routes[Math.floor(Math.random()*routes.length)], user }); }
  }
  an.sessions=an.sessions.slice(-2000); an.events=an.events.slice(-4000);
  saveJSON(ANALYTICS,an);
  const accts=loadJSON(ACCT,{}); users.forEach(u=>{ if(!accts[u]) accts[u]={name:u.split('@')[0], onboarded:Math.random()<0.7}; }); saveJSON(ACCT,accts);
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   Server mode. Served by the Lumera server, the portal signs in with a
   member account, the server checks the admin role on every request, and
   content changes are saved to the server so they reach every member.
   Opened from disk or a static host there is no server, so it falls back
   to the offline key gate and edits this browser's storage only.
   ============================================================ */
/* Preview mode (previews/admin.html): the real portal UI, running against
   invented example data instead of a server. Nothing is saved anywhere. */
const PREVIEW = /[?&]preview=1\b/.test(location.search) || (function(){ try{ return window.parent!==window && !!window.parent.__LUMERA_ADMIN_PREVIEW; }catch(e){ return false; } })();
const DAYMS = 864e5, NOWMS = Date.now();
const EX = {
  user:{ id:1, email:'admin@example.com', name:'Example Admin', role:'admin', isAdmin:true },
  users:[
    { id:1, email:'admin@example.com', name:'Example Admin', role:'admin', status:'active', created_at:NOWMS-90*DAYMS, last_login_at:NOWMS-3600e3, onboarded:true, posts:2 },
    { id:2, email:'maya@example.com', name:'Maya (example)', role:'user', status:'active', created_at:NOWMS-40*DAYMS, last_login_at:NOWMS-5*3600e3, onboarded:true, posts:4 },
    { id:3, email:'theo@example.com', name:'Theo (example)', role:'user', status:'active', created_at:NOWMS-12*DAYMS, last_login_at:NOWMS-DAYMS, onboarded:true, posts:1 },
    { id:4, email:'sam@example.com', name:'Sam (example)', role:'user', status:'disabled', created_at:NOWMS-8*DAYMS, last_login_at:NOWMS-6*DAYMS, onboarded:false, posts:0 },
  ],
  posts:[
    { id:11, tag:'Milestone', body:'Hit three months of emergency savings today.', link:'', hidden:false, created_at:NOWMS-2*3600e3, email:'maya@example.com', name:'Maya (example)', reports:0, likes:24 },
    { id:12, tag:'Question', body:'Pension top-up or clear a £900 card first?', link:'', hidden:false, created_at:NOWMS-5*3600e3, email:'theo@example.com', name:'Theo (example)', reports:1, likes:11 },
  ],
  reports:{ member:[{ id:21, kind:'post', target_id:12, reason:'Looks like financial advice', reporter:'maya@example.com', content:'Pension top-up or clear a £900 card first?', status:'open', created_at:NOWMS-3600e3 }],
    error:[{ id:31, kind:'error', reason:'TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined', detail:{ path:'/budget', ua:'Example browser', stack:'at Budget (app.html:1:1)' }, reporter:null, status:'open', created_at:NOWMS-7200e3 }] },
  companies:[
    { key:'netflix', name:'Netflix', domain:'netflix.com', status:'found', source:'auto', locked:false, checkedAt:NOWMS-DAYMS, logoUrl:'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=netflix.com&sz=128' },
    { key:'spotify', name:'Spotify', domain:'spotify.com', status:'found', source:'auto', locked:false, checkedAt:NOWMS-DAYMS, logoUrl:'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=spotify.com&sz=128' },
    { key:'boutique gym app', name:'Boutique gym app', domain:null, status:'missing', source:'auto', locked:false, checkedAt:NOWMS-DAYMS, logoUrl:null },
  ],
  audit:[{ id:1, action:'post.hide', target:'9', at:NOWMS-86e5, actor:'admin@example.com' },{ id:2, action:'config.flags', target:'', at:NOWMS-2*86e5, actor:'admin@example.com' }],
};
function previewApi(method, path){
  const u = new URL(path, 'http://x'); const p = u.pathname;
  if(method !== 'GET'){
    if(p === '/api/auth/login' || p === '/api/auth/logout') return { user:EX.user, ok:true };
    if(/reset-link$/.test(p)) return { path:'/app.html#/reset?token=example-only', expiresAt:NOWMS+3600e3 };
    toast('Preview only: example data, nothing is saved.'); return { ok:true, company:EX.companies[0] };
  }
  if(p === '/api/health') return { ok:true, service:'lumera', version:'preview', time:NOWMS };
  if(p === '/api/auth/me' || p === '/api/auth/session') return { user:EX.user };
  if(p === '/api/admin/overview') return { openFeedback:2, server:{ env:'preview', mail:false, feedback:true, sitePassword:true }, users:4, admins:1, disabled:1, activeThisWeek:3, onboarded:3, posts:2, hiddenPosts:0, openReports:1, openErrors:1, companies:3, companiesMissing:1, waitlist:{ Pro:12, Premium:5 } };
  if(p === '/api/admin/users') return { users:EX.users, more:false };
  if(p === '/api/admin/posts') return { posts:EX.posts };
  if(p === '/api/admin/reports') return { reports: u.searchParams.get('status') === 'resolved' ? [] : EX.reports[u.searchParams.get('kind') === 'error' ? 'error' : 'member'] };
  if(p === '/api/admin/companies') return { companies:EX.companies };
  if(p === '/api/admin/audit') return { entries:EX.audit };
  if(p === '/api/admin/feedback') return { feedback: u.searchParams.get('status') === 'resolved' ? [] : [
    { id:41, kind:'bug', message:'On my phone the goals page jumps when I scroll. (example)', page:'/goals', contact:'', email:'maya@example.com', user_agent:'Example browser', status:'open', created_at:NOWMS-2*3600e3 },
    { id:42, kind:'idea', message:'Could the dashboard show last month next to this month? (example)', page:'/dashboard', contact:'Theo', email:null, user_agent:'', status:'open', created_at:NOWMS-DAYMS }] };
  if(p === '/api/admin/config') return { flags:null, layout:null, updates:null, news:null, about:null };
  if(p === '/api/admin/waitlist') return { entries:[{ plan:'Pro', name:'Maya (example)', email:'maya@example.com', created_at:NOWMS-DAYMS }] };
  return {};
}
const API = {
  async req(method, path, body){
    if(PREVIEW) return previewApi(method, path);
    const headers = { 'X-Lumera':'1' };
    if(body !== undefined) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    let res;
    try{ res = await fetch(path, { method, credentials:'same-origin', cache:'no-store', headers, body: body===undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) }); }
    catch(e){ const err = new Error('Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.'); err.offline = true; throw err; }
    let data = null; try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(e){}
    if(!res.ok){
      const err = new Error((data && data.error) || ('The server returned ' + res.status + '.'));
      err.status = res.status; err.code = data && data.code;
      if(res.status === 401 && MODE === 'server' && ME) sessionEnded('Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.');
      if(res.status === 403 && err.code !== 'csrf' && MODE === 'server' && ME) sessionEnded('This account no longer has admin access.');
      throw err;
    }
    return data;
  },
  get(p){ return this.req('GET', p); },
  post(p, b){ return this.req('POST', p, b || {}); },
  put(p, b){ return this.req('PUT', p, b || {}); },
  patch(p, b){ return this.req('PATCH', p, b || {}); },
  del(p, b){ return this.req('DELETE', p, b); },
};

async function detectServer(){
  if(PREVIEW) return true;
  if(!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)) return false;
  try{
    const r = await fetch('/api/health', { credentials:'same-origin', cache:'no-store' });
    if(!r.ok) return false;
    const j = await r.json();
    return !!(j && j.service === 'lumera');
  }catch(e){ return false; }
}

// Portal storage keys that the server keeps for everyone, and their config names.
const CONFIG_MAP = { lumera_flags:'flags', lumera_layout:'layout', lumera_updates:'updates', lumera_news:'news', lumera_about:'about' };
const pendingCfg = {}; let cfgTimer = null, cfgChain = Promise.resolve();
function saveJSON(k, v){
  try{ __LS.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){}
  if(MODE === 'server' && CONFIG_MAP[k]){
    pendingCfg[CONFIG_MAP[k]] = v; SERVER_EMPTY[CONFIG_MAP[k]] = false;
    clearTimeout(cfgTimer); cfgTimer = setTimeout(flushConfig, 250);
    setStatus('saving');
  }
}
function flushConfig(){
  const body = Object.assign({}, pendingCfg);
  Object.keys(pendingCfg).forEach(k=>{ delete pendingCfg[k]; });
  if(!Object.keys(body).length) return;
  cfgChain = cfgChain.then(()=>API.put('/api/admin/config', body))
    .then(()=>setStatus('saved'))
    .catch(e=>{ setStatus('error'); toast(e.status === 413 ? 'That is too large to save. Use smaller photos.' : e.message, true); });
}
async function loadServerConfig(){
  const cfg = await API.get('/api/admin/config');
  Object.entries(CONFIG_MAP).forEach(([key, name])=>{
    const v = cfg[name];
    SERVER_EMPTY[name] = (v == null);
    try{
      if(v != null) __LS.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(v));
      else if(name === 'updates') __LS.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(UPDATES_SEED));  // what members see today
      else __LS.removeItem(key);
    }catch(e){}
  });
}

/* ---- status + toasts ---- */
function setStatus(state){
  const dot = document.getElementById('statusDot'), txt = document.getElementById('statusText');
  if(!dot || !txt) return;
  dot.className = 'live-dot';
  if(MODE === 'local'){
    const live = ['dashboard','insights','usage'].includes(ACTIVE_TAB);
    dot.classList.add('warn'); txt.textContent = live ? 'Offline · this browser · refreshing 3s' : 'Offline · saved in this browser only';
    return;
  }
  if(state === 'saving'){ dot.classList.add('warn'); txt.textContent = 'Saving…'; return; }
  if(state === 'error'){ dot.classList.add('bad'); txt.textContent = 'Not saved'; return; }
  txt.textContent = PREVIEW ? 'Preview · example data' : state === 'saved' ? 'Saved to the server' : 'Connected to the server';
}
let toastTimer = null;
function toast(msg, bad){
  let t = document.getElementById('toast');
  if(!t){ t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'toast'; t.setAttribute('role','status'); document.body.appendChild(t); }
  t.className = 'toast' + (bad ? ' bad' : ''); t.textContent = msg; t.hidden = false;
  clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ t.hidden = true; }, bad ? 6000 : 2600);
}

/* ---- sign in / out ---- */
function gateMsg(text){ document.getElementById('gateLede').textContent = text; }
async function signIn(){
  const email = document.getElementById('gEmail').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('gPass').value;
  const err = document.getElementById('gErrS'), btn = document.getElementById('gBtn');
  err.textContent = '';
  if(!email || !password){ err.textContent = 'Enter your email and password.'; return; }
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Signing in…';
  try{
    const r = await API.post('/api/auth/login', { email, password });
    if(!r.user || r.user.role !== 'admin'){
      await API.post('/api/auth/logout').catch(()=>{});
      err.textContent = 'This account does not have admin access.';
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('gPass').value = '';
    await enterServer(r.user);
  }catch(e){
    err.textContent = e.status === 401 ? 'That email and password do not match an account.' : e.message;
  }finally{ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Sign in'; }
}
async function enterServer(user){
  ME = user; CURRENT_ROLE = 'admin';
  try{ await loadServerConfig(); }
  catch(e){ ME = null; CURRENT_ROLE = null; document.getElementById('gErrS').textContent = e.message; return; }
  showApp();
  refreshCounts();
}
function sessionEnded(msg){
  ME = null; CURRENT_ROLE = null; ACTIVE_TAB = null; clearInterval(DASH_TIMER);
  closeModal();
  document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gate').style.display = 'grid';
  gateMsg('Sign in with an admin account.');
  document.getElementById('gErrS').textContent = msg || '';
}

/* ---- shared bits for the server views ---- */
const fmtDate = (ms)=> ms ? new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric' }) : '—';
const fmtWhen = (ms)=> ms ? new Date(ms).toLocaleString(undefined, { day:'numeric', month:'short', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' }) : '—';
const skeleton = (n)=> '<div class="card">' + Array.from({ length:n || 4 }, (_, i)=>`<div class="skel" style="width:${92 - i * 11}%"></div>`).join('') + '</div>';
async function serverView(tab, title, desc, build){
  C.innerHTML = pageHead(title, desc) + skeleton();
  try{
    const html = await build();
    if(ACTIVE_TAB !== tab) return;
    C.innerHTML = pageHead(title, desc) + html;
  }catch(e){
    if(ACTIVE_TAB !== tab || !ME) return;
    C.innerHTML = pageHead(title, desc) + `<div class="card empty"><p style="margin:0 0 12px;">${escapeHtml(e.message)}</p>
      <button class="btn" onclick="render()">Try again</button></div>`;
  }
}
async function act(promise, okMsg){
  try{ await promise; if(okMsg) toast(okMsg); render(); refreshCounts(); return true; }
  catch(e){ toast(e.message, true); return false; }
}
async function refreshCounts(){
  if(MODE !== 'server' || !ME) return;
  try{
    const o = await API.get('/api/admin/overview');
    { const fb = document.getElementById('fbCount'); if(fb){ fb.hidden = !o.openFeedback; fb.textContent = o.openFeedback || ''; } }
    const n = o.openReports + o.openErrors, el = document.getElementById('repCount');
    if(el){ el.hidden = !n; el.textContent = n; }
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ---- overview ---- */
function renderOverview(){
  serverView('overview', 'Overview', PREVIEW ? 'Example figures for the preview. In the live portal these come straight from the database.' : `Signed in as ${escapeHtml(ME.email)}. These figures come straight from the database.`, async()=>{
    const [o, health] = await Promise.all([API.get('/api/admin/overview'), API.get('/api/health').catch(()=>({}))]);
    SYS = health || {};
    const todo = [];
    if(o.openReports) todo.push(`<button class="btn" onclick="R_STATE.kind='member';R_STATE.status='open';switchTab('reports')">${o.openReports} member report${o.openReports === 1 ? '' : 's'} to review</button>`);
    if(o.openErrors) todo.push(`<button class="btn" onclick="R_STATE.kind='error';R_STATE.status='open';switchTab('reports')">${o.openErrors} app error${o.openErrors === 1 ? '' : 's'} reported</button>`);
    if(o.companiesMissing) todo.push(`<button class="btn" onclick="switchTab('companies')">${o.companiesMissing} subscription${o.companiesMissing === 1 ? '' : 's'} without a logo</button>`);
    return `<div class="row cols-4">
        ${kpi('Accounts', o.users, `${o.admins} admin${o.admins === 1 ? '' : 's'}`)}
        ${kpi('Active · 7 days', o.activeThisWeek, 'Signed in this week')}
        ${kpi('Onboarded', o.onboarded, 'Saved their figures')}
        ${kpi('Disabled', o.disabled, 'Cannot sign in')}
      </div>
      <div class="row cols-4">
        ${kpi('Community posts', o.posts, `${o.hiddenPosts} hidden`)}
        ${kpi('Open reports', o.openReports, 'From members')}
        ${kpi('App errors', o.openErrors, 'Open')}
        ${kpi('Companies', o.companies, `${o.companiesMissing} without a logo`)}
      </div>
      <div class="row cols-3">
        <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Needs attention</div>
          ${todo.length ? `<div class="toolbar">${todo.join('')}</div>` : '<p class="muted" style="margin:0;">Nothing waiting. Reports, app errors and missing logos show up here.</p>'}
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">System status</div>
          <div class="toolbar"><span class="pill live"><span class="live-dot"></span> Server ${escapeHtml(SYS.version || 'online')}</span>
            <span class="pill">${SYS.time ? 'Checked ' + escapeHtml(fmtWhen(SYS.time)) : ''}</span></div>
          ${o.server ? `<div class="toolbar" style="margin-top:8px">
            <span class="pill ${o.server.env === 'production' ? 'gold' : ''}">${escapeHtml(o.server.env || '')}</span>
            <span class="pill ${o.server.mail ? 'live' : 'unp'}">Email ${o.server.mail ? 'on' : 'off'}</span>
            <span class="pill">${o.server.feedback ? 'Feedback button on' : 'Feedback button off'}</span>
            <span class="pill">${o.server.sitePassword ? 'Site password on' : 'No site password'}</span></div>` : ''}
          <p class="muted" style="margin:10px 0 0;font-size:13px;">${o.server && !o.server.mail ? 'Email is off, so members cannot reset their own password: issue reset links from Accounts. ' : ''}See BACKEND.md for configuration.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Plan waitlist</div>
          <p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13px;">Members who asked to be emailed when a paid plan launches.</p>
          <div class="toolbar"><span class="pill gold">Pro · ${(o.waitlist && o.waitlist.Pro) || 0}</span><span class="pill gold">Premium · ${(o.waitlist && o.waitlist.Premium) || 0}</span>
            <span class="grow"></span>${(o.waitlist && Object.values(o.waitlist).some(Boolean)) ? '<button class="btn sm" onclick="downloadWaitlist()">Download CSV</button>' : ''}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  });
}
// Spreadsheet-safe CSV: quoted fields, and no cell that starts like a formula.
function csvCell(v){ let t = String(v == null ? '' : v); if(/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(t)) t = "'" + t; return '"' + t.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }
async function downloadWaitlist(){
  try{
    const r = await API.get('/api/admin/waitlist');
    const lines = [['Plan','Name','Email','Joined'].map(csvCell).join(',')]
      .concat(r.entries.map(e=>[e.plan, e.name, e.email, new Date(e.created_at).toISOString()].map(csvCell).join(',')));
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join('\r\n')], { type:'text/csv' }));
    const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = `lumera-waitlist-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`; a.click();
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  }catch(e){ toast(e.message, true); }
}

/* ---- accounts ---- */
const U_STATE = { q:'', page:0 };
let uSearchTimer = null;
function renderUsers(){
  serverView('users', 'Accounts', 'Everyone with a Lumera account. Change roles, disable access or issue a password reset link.', async()=>{
    const r = await API.get(`/api/admin/users?q=${encodeURIComponent(U_STATE.q)}&page=${U_STATE.page}`);
    const rows = r.users.map(u=>{
      const self = u.id === ME.id;
      return `<tr>
        <td><div style="font-weight:600;">${escapeHtml(u.name)}${self ? ' <span class="pill gold">You</span>' : ''}</div><div class="faint" style="font-size:12px;">${escapeHtml(u.email)}</div></td>
        <td>${u.role === 'admin' ? '<span class="pill gold">Admin</span>' : '<span class="pill">Member</span>'}</td>
        <td>${u.status === 'disabled' ? '<span class="pill bad">Disabled</span>' : '<span class="pill live">Active</span>'}</td>
        <td class="faint">${fmtDate(u.created_at)}</td>
        <td class="faint">${fmtWhen(u.last_login_at)}</td>
        <td class="tnum">${u.onboarded ? 'Yes' : '<span class="faint">No</span>'}</td>
        <td class="tnum">${u.posts}</td>
        <td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;">
          ${self ? '' : (u.role === 'admin'
            ? `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="setRole(${u.id},'user')">Remove admin</button>`
            : `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="setRole(${u.id},'admin')">Make admin</button>`)}
          ${self ? '' : (u.status === 'disabled'
            ? `<button class="btn sm" onclick="setUserStatus(${u.id},'active')">Enable</button>`
            : `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="setUserStatus(${u.id},'disabled')">Disable</button>`)}
          <button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="resetLink(${u.id})">Reset link</button>
          ${self ? '' : `<button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteUser(${u.id})">Delete</button>`}
        </div></td></tr>`;
    }).join('');
    USERS_CACHE = {}; r.users.forEach(u=>{ USERS_CACHE[u.id] = u; });
    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;"><div class="toolbar">
        <label class="sr-only" for="uSearch">Search accounts</label>
        <input id="uSearch" class="grow" type="search" placeholder="Search by name or email" value="${escapeHtml(U_STATE.q)}" oninput="searchUsers(this.value)" autocomplete="off"/>
        <span class="faint" style="font-size:12px;">${r.users.length}${r.more ? '+' : ''} shown</span>
      </div></div>
      <div class="card tbl">${r.users.length ? `<table><thead><tr><th>Account</th><th>Role</th><th>Status</th><th>Joined</th><th>Last sign-in</th><th>Onboarded</th><th>Posts</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`
        : `<p class="empty">${U_STATE.q ? 'No accounts match that search.' : 'No accounts yet.'}</p>`}
        ${(U_STATE.page > 0 || r.more) ? `<div class="toolbar" style="justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:12px;">
          <button class="btn sm ghost" ${U_STATE.page === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="U_STATE.page--;render()">&larr; Newer</button>
          <button class="btn sm ghost" ${r.more ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="U_STATE.page++;render()">Older &rarr;</button></div>` : ''}
      </div>`;
  }).then(()=>{ const s = document.getElementById('uSearch'); if(s && U_STATE.q && document.activeElement !== s){ s.focus(); s.setSelectionRange(s.value.length, s.value.length); } });
}
let USERS_CACHE = {};
function searchUsers(v){ clearTimeout(uSearchTimer); uSearchTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ U_STATE.q = v.trim(); U_STATE.page = 0; render(); }, 300); }
function confirmModal(title, text, label, danger, onOk, extra){
  document.body.appendChild(mkModal(`<h3>${title}</h3><p class="muted" style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0;line-height:1.55;">${text}</p>${extra || ''}
    <div class="acts"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="btn ${danger ? 'danger' : 'gold'}" id="mdOk">${label}</button></div>`));
  document.getElementById('mdOk').onclick = onOk;
}
function setRole(id, role){
  const u = USERS_CACHE[id]; if(!u) return;
  const grant = role === 'admin';
  confirmModal(grant ? 'Make this account an admin?' : 'Remove admin access?',
    grant ? `<strong>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</strong> will be able to manage accounts, community posts, content and settings.`
          : `<strong>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</strong> will go back to a member account and lose access to this portal.`,
    grant ? 'Make admin' : 'Remove admin', !grant,
    ()=>{ closeModal(); act(API.patch('/api/admin/users/' + id, { role }), grant ? 'Admin access granted.' : 'Admin access removed.'); });
}
function setUserStatus(id, status){
  const u = USERS_CACHE[id]; if(!u) return;
  if(status === 'active'){ act(API.patch('/api/admin/users/' + id, { status }), 'Account enabled.'); return; }
  confirmModal('Disable this account?', `<strong>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</strong> will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you enable the account again. Their data is kept.`,
    'Disable account', true, ()=>{ closeModal(); act(API.patch('/api/admin/users/' + id, { status }), 'Account disabled.'); });
}
async function resetLink(id){
  const u = USERS_CACHE[id]; if(!u) return;
  try{
    const r = await API.post(`/api/admin/users/${id}/reset-link`);
    const url = new URL(r.path, location.href).href;
    document.body.appendChild(mkModal(`<h3>Password reset link</h3>
      <p class="muted" style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.55;">${r.emailed ? `We emailed this link to <strong>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</strong>. You can also copy it below.` : `Send this to <strong>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</strong> yourself (email is not switched on).`} It works once and expires at ${escapeHtml(fmtWhen(r.expiresAt))}.</p>
      <label class="sr-only" for="rlUrl">Reset link</label>
      <input id="rlUrl" readonly value="${escapeHtml(url)}" onclick="this.select()"/>
      <div class="acts"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Done</button><button class="btn gold" onclick="copyField('rlUrl')">Copy link</button></div>`));
  }catch(e){ toast(e.message, true); }
}
function copyField(id){
  const el = document.getElementById(id); if(!el) return;
  el.select();
  const done = ()=>toast('Copied.');
  if(navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.value).then(done, ()=>{ document.execCommand('copy'); done(); });
  else { try{ document.execCommand('copy'); done(); }catch(e){ toast('Select the link and copy it.', true); } }
}
function deleteUser(id){
  const u = USERS_CACHE[id]; if(!u) return;
  confirmModal('Delete this account?', `This permanently deletes <strong>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</strong>, their saved figures, community posts, replies and connections. It cannot be undone.`,
    'Delete account', true, ()=>{
      const v = (document.getElementById('mdConfirm') || {}).value || '';
      if(v.trim().toLowerCase() !== u.email.toLowerCase()){ document.getElementById('mdErr').textContent = 'Type the email address exactly to confirm.'; return; }
      closeModal(); act(API.del('/api/admin/users/' + id), 'Account deleted.');
    },
    `<div style="height:12px"></div><label class="fl" for="mdConfirm">Type the email address to confirm</label><input id="mdConfirm" autocomplete="off"/><p class="err" id="mdErr" style="color:var(--berry);font-size:12.5px;margin:6px 0 0;"></p>`);
}

/* ---- community moderation ---- */
const P_STATE = { filter:'all' };
function renderPosts(){
  const seg = ['all','reported','hidden'].map(f=>`<button class="${P_STATE.filter === f ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="P_STATE.filter='${f}';render()">${f[0].toUpperCase() + f.slice(1)}</button>`).join('');
  serverView('posts', 'Community', 'Posts from the member feed. Hiding a post removes it from the feed for everyone and resolves its reports; you can show it again later.', async()=>{
    const r = await API.get('/api/admin/posts?filter=' + P_STATE.filter);
    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;"><div class="toolbar"><div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Filter posts">${seg}</div>
        <span class="faint" style="font-size:12px;">${r.posts.length} post${r.posts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}${r.posts.length === 100 ? ' (latest 100)' : ''}</span></div></div>
      <div class="card">${r.posts.length ? r.posts.map(p=>`<div class="upd"><div class="ic">${escapeHtml((p.name || '?').trim()[0] || '?')}</div><div class="body">
          <h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(p.name)} <span class="faint" style="font-weight:400;font-size:12px;">${escapeHtml(p.email)}</span></h3>
          <div class="meta"><span class="pill gold">${escapeHtml(p.tag)}</span><span>${fmtWhen(p.created_at)}</span><span>${p.likes} like${p.likes === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
            ${p.reports ? `<span class="pill bad">${p.reports} open report${p.reports === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>` : ''}${p.hidden ? '<span class="pill unp">Hidden</span>' : ''}</div>
          <p class="desc">${escapeHtml(p.body)}</p>${p.link ? `<p class="desc" style="margin-top:6px;"><a href="${escapeHtml(p.link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" style="color:var(--goldd);">${escapeHtml(p.link)}</a></p>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="acts">${p.hidden ? `<button class="btn sm" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/posts/${p.id}',{hidden:false}),'Post shown again.')">Show</button>`
                                     : `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/posts/${p.id}',{hidden:true}),'Post hidden.')">Hide</button>`}
          <button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deletePost(${p.id})">Delete</button></div></div>`).join('')
        : `<p class="empty">${P_STATE.filter === 'reported' ? 'No posts with open reports.' : P_STATE.filter === 'hidden' ? 'No hidden posts.' : 'No community posts yet.'}</p>`}</div>`;
  });
}
function deletePost(id){
  confirmModal('Delete this post?', 'The post, its replies and likes are removed for everyone. It cannot be undone. Hide it instead if you might want it back.',
    'Delete post', true, ()=>{ closeModal(); act(API.del('/api/admin/posts/' + id), 'Post deleted.'); });
}

/* ---- reports ---- */
const R_STATE = { kind:'member', status:'open' };
function renderReports(){
  const segK = [['member','Member reports'],['error','App errors']].map(([k, l])=>`<button class="${R_STATE.kind === k ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="R_STATE.kind='${k}';render()">${l}</button>`).join('');
  const segS = [['open','Open'],['resolved','Resolved']].map(([k, l])=>`<button class="${R_STATE.status === k ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="R_STATE.status='${k}';render()">${l}</button>`).join('');
  serverView('reports', 'Reports', 'What members have flagged in the community, and errors the app has reported from members’ browsers.', async()=>{
    const r = await API.get(`/api/admin/reports?kind=${R_STATE.kind}&status=${R_STATE.status}`);
    const toggle = (x)=> x.status === 'open'
      ? `<button class="btn sm" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/reports/${x.id}',{status:'resolved'}),'Marked resolved.')">Resolve</button>`
      : `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/reports/${x.id}',{status:'open'}),'Reopened.')">Reopen</button>`;
    const list = r.reports.map(x=> R_STATE.kind === 'error'
      ? `<div class="upd"><div class="ic">!</div><div class="body">
          <h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(x.reason)}</h3>
          <div class="meta"><span>${fmtWhen(x.created_at)}</span>${x.detail && x.detail.path ? `<code>${escapeHtml(x.detail.path)}</code>` : ''}<span>${escapeHtml(x.reporter || 'Signed out')}</span></div>
          ${x.detail && x.detail.ua ? `<p class="desc faint" style="font-size:12px;">${escapeHtml(x.detail.ua)}</p>` : ''}
          ${x.detail && x.detail.stack ? `<details style="margin-top:6px;"><summary class="faint" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;">Stack trace</summary><pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;">${escapeHtml(x.detail.stack)}</pre></details>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="acts">${toggle(x)}</div></div>`
      : `<div class="upd"><div class="ic">⚑</div><div class="body">
          <h3 class="ttl">${escapeHtml(x.reason || 'No reason given')}</h3>
          <div class="meta"><span class="pill">${x.kind === 'reply' ? 'Reply' : 'Post'} #${x.target_id}</span><span>${fmtWhen(x.created_at)}</span><span>Reported by ${escapeHtml(x.reporter || 'a deleted account')}</span></div>
          <p class="desc">${x.content != null ? escapeHtml(x.content) : '<span class="faint">The reported content has been deleted.</span>'}</p></div>
        <div class="acts">${x.status === 'open' && x.content != null ? `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/reports/${x.id}',{status:'resolved',hideTarget:true}),'Hidden and resolved.')">Hide &amp; resolve</button>` : ''}${toggle(x)}</div></div>`).join('');
    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;"><div class="toolbar">
        <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Report type">${segK}</div><div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Report status">${segS}</div></div></div>
      <div class="card">${list || `<p class="empty">${R_STATE.status === 'open' ? 'Nothing open. ' : ''}${R_STATE.kind === 'error' ? 'No app errors here.' : 'No member reports here.'}</p>`}</div>`;
  });
}

/* ---- team feedback (the "Feedback" button in the app) ---- */
const FB_STATE = { status:'open' };
function renderTeamFeedback(){
  const segS = [['open','Open'],['resolved','Resolved']].map(([k, l])=>`<button class="${FB_STATE.status === k ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="FB_STATE.status='${k}';render()">${l}</button>`).join('');
  const KIND = { bug:['Bug','#F43F5E'], idea:['Idea','#F59E0B'], opinion:['Opinion','#8B5CF6'] };
  serverView('teamfeedback', 'Team feedback', 'What people sent with the Feedback button: bugs, ideas and opinions, newest first.', async()=>{
    const r = await API.get(`/api/admin/feedback?status=${FB_STATE.status}`);
    const list = r.feedback.map(f=>{ const k = KIND[f.kind] || [f.kind,'#888'];
      return `<div class="upd"><div class="ic" style="background:${k[1]}22;color:${k[1]}">${escapeHtml(k[0][0])}</div><div class="body">
        <div class="meta"><span class="pill" style="background:${k[1]}22;color:${k[1]}">${escapeHtml(k[0])}</span><span>${fmtWhen(f.created_at)}</span>${f.page ? `<code>${escapeHtml(f.page)}</code>` : ''}<span>${escapeHtml(f.email || f.contact || 'Not signed in')}</span></div>
        <p class="desc" style="white-space:pre-wrap">${escapeHtml(f.message)}</p>
        ${f.user_agent ? `<p class="desc faint" style="font-size:11.5px;">${escapeHtml(f.user_agent)}</p>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="acts">${f.status === 'open'
          ? `<button class="btn sm" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/feedback/${f.id}',{status:'resolved'}),'Marked done.')">Done</button>`
          : `<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="act(API.patch('/api/admin/feedback/${f.id}',{status:'open'}),'Reopened.')">Reopen</button>`}</div></div>`; }).join('');
    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;"><div class="toolbar"><div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Feedback status">${segS}</div></div></div>
      <div class="card">${list || `<p class="empty">${FB_STATE.status === 'open' ? 'Nothing open. ' : ''}No feedback here yet.</p>`}</div>`;
  });
}

/* ---- subscription logos ---- */
let CO_LIST = [];
function renderCompanies(){
  serverView('companies', 'Subscription logos', 'Members’ subscriptions show the company’s logo, looked up once on the server and cached. Set a domain to fix a wrong or missing logo; domains you set are locked and never overwritten by the automatic lookup.', async()=>{
    const r = await API.get('/api/admin/companies');
    CO_LIST = r.companies;
    const pill = (c)=> c.status === 'found' ? '<span class="pill live">Logo found</span>' : c.status === 'missing' ? '<span class="pill unp">No logo</span>' : '<span class="pill">Pending</span>';
    const letter = (c)=> escapeHtml((c.name.trim()[0] || '?').toUpperCase());
    const tile = (c)=> c.logoUrl
      ? `<span class="logo-tile" data-letter="${letter(c)}"><img src="${escapeHtml(c.logoUrl)}?v=${c.checkedAt || 0}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="logoFail(this)"/></span>`
      : `<span class="logo-tile mono">${letter(c)}</span>`;
    const rows = r.companies.map((c, i)=>`<tr>
        <td><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">${tile(c)}<span style="font-weight:600;">${escapeHtml(c.name)}</span></div></td>
        <td>${c.domain ? `<code>${escapeHtml(c.domain)}</code>` : '<span class="faint">—</span>'}${c.locked ? ' <span class="pill gold" title="Set by an admin">Locked</span>' : ''}</td>
        <td>${pill(c)}</td>
        <td class="faint">${fmtDate(c.checkedAt)}</td>
        <td><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;">
          <button class="btn sm" onclick="setCompanyDomain(${i})">Set domain</button>
          <button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="refreshCompany(${i})">Look up again</button>
          <button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteCompany(${i})">Remove</button></div></td></tr>`).join('');
    return `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px;"><div class="eyebrow">Add a company</div>
        <form class="toolbar" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); addCompany();">
          <label class="sr-only" for="coName">Company name</label><input id="coName" class="grow" placeholder="Company name, e.g. Notion" maxlength="80" required/>
          <label class="sr-only" for="coDomain">Domain (optional)</label><input id="coDomain" class="grow" placeholder="Domain (optional), e.g. notion.so" maxlength="120"/>
          <button class="btn gold" type="submit" id="coBtn">Add</button></form></div>
      <div class="card tbl">${r.companies.length ? `<table><thead><tr><th>Company</th><th>Domain</th><th>Status</th><th>Checked</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`
        : '<p class="empty">No companies yet. They appear here as members add subscriptions, or add one above.</p>'}</div>`;
  });
}
async function addCompany(){
  const name = document.getElementById('coName').value.trim(), domain = document.getElementById('coDomain').value.trim();
  if(!name){ toast('Enter a company name.', true); return; }
  const btn = document.getElementById('coBtn'); btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Looking up…';
  const ok = await act(API.post('/api/admin/companies', domain ? { name, domain } : { name }), 'Company saved.');
  if(!ok){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Add'; }
}
function logoFail(img){ const t = img.parentNode; t.className = 'logo-tile mono'; t.textContent = t.getAttribute('data-letter') || '?'; }
function setCompanyDomain(i){
  const c = CO_LIST[i]; if(!c) return;
  document.body.appendChild(mkModal(`<h3>Set the domain for ${escapeHtml(c.name)}</h3>
    <p class="muted" style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.55;">The logo is fetched from this domain and the entry is locked, so automatic lookups leave it alone.</p>
    <form onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); saveCompanyDomain(${i});">
      <label class="fl" for="cdDomain">Domain</label><input id="cdDomain" value="${escapeHtml(c.domain || '')}" placeholder="example.com" required/>
      <div class="acts"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button><button type="submit" class="btn gold" id="cdBtn">Save</button></div></form>`));
  setTimeout(()=>{ const i = document.getElementById('cdDomain'); if(i) i.focus(); }, 50);
}
async function saveCompanyDomain(i){
  const c = CO_LIST[i]; if(!c) return;
  const domain = document.getElementById('cdDomain').value.trim(), btn = document.getElementById('cdBtn');
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Fetching logo…';
  try{ await API.put('/api/admin/companies/' + encodeURIComponent(c.key), { domain, name:c.name }); closeModal(); toast('Domain saved.'); render(); }
  catch(e){ toast(e.message, true); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Save'; }
}
function refreshCompany(i){ const c = CO_LIST[i]; if(!c) return; toast('Looking up…'); act(API.post('/api/admin/companies/' + encodeURIComponent(c.key) + '/refresh'), 'Lookup finished.'); }
function deleteCompany(i){
  const c = CO_LIST[i]; if(!c) return;
  confirmModal('Remove this company?', `<strong>${escapeHtml(c.name)}</strong> is removed from the cache. If a member still has it as a subscription, it is looked up again the next time it is shown.`,
    'Remove', true, ()=>{ closeModal(); act(API.del('/api/admin/companies/' + encodeURIComponent(c.key)), 'Removed.'); });
}

/* ---- audit log ---- */
function renderAudit(){
  serverView('audit', 'Audit log', 'Every admin action, newest first (the latest 200).', async()=>{
    const r = await API.get('/api/admin/audit');
    return `<div class="card tbl">${r.entries.length ? `<table><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Admin</th><th>Action</th><th>Detail</th></tr></thead><tbody>
      ${r.entries.map(a=>`<tr><td class="faint" style="white-space:nowrap;">${fmtWhen(a.at)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(a.actor || 'Deleted account')}</td><td><code>${escapeHtml(a.action)}</code></td><td class="muted" style="overflow-wrap:anywhere;">${escapeHtml(a.target)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
      </tbody></table>` : '<p class="empty">No admin actions yet.</p>'}</div>`;
  });
}

/* Team photos are resized before saving, so the About content stays small. */
function shrinkImage(file, max){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file), img = new Image();
    img.onload = ()=>{
      const s = Math.min(1, (max || 640) / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
      const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = Math.round(img.width * s); c.height = Math.round(img.height * s);
      c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86));
    };
    img.onerror = ()=>{ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(new Error('That file could not be read as an image.')); };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('[data-icon]').forEach(el=>{
  const p = ICONS[el.getAttribute('data-icon')];
  if(p) el.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${p}</svg>`);
});

(async function boot(){
  let server = await detectServer();
  // On the hosted site the portal only ever works against the server. The
  // local "team key" mode is for the offline preview files.
  const hosted = /^https?:$/.test(location.protocol) && !PREVIEW;
  for(let i = 0; hosted && !server && i < 2; i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, 1500)); server = await detectServer(); }
  if(hosted && !server){
    document.body.innerHTML = '<main style="min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eee;background:#16122C"><div style="max-width:420px;text-align:center"><h1 style="font-weight:600">Cannot reach the Lumera server</h1><p style="opacity:.8">The admin portal needs the server. Check your connection and try again.</p><button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:12px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:#9D7CFF;color:#fff;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer">Try again</button></div></main>';
    return;
  }
  MODE = server ? 'server' : 'local';
  document.body.setAttribute('data-mode', MODE);
  if(PREVIEW) document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<div role="note" style="position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;text-align:center;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9D7CFF,#F08BC4);color:#fff">Admin portal preview · example data only, not connected to a server</div>');
  document.getElementById('lockBtn').lastChild.textContent = server ? 'Sign out' : 'Lock portal';
  if(!server){
    gateMsg('Enter your team key.');
    try{ const r = __SS.getItem('lumera_admin_role'); if(r && ROLES[r] && r !== 'admin'){ CURRENT_ROLE = r; showApp(); return; } }catch(e){}
    setTimeout(()=>{ const k = document.getElementById('key'); if(k) k.focus(); }, 50);
    return;
  }
  gateMsg('Sign in with an admin account.');
  try{
    const me = await API.get('/api/auth/session');
    if(me && me.user && me.user.role === 'admin'){ await enterServer(me.user); return; }
    if(me && me.user) document.getElementById('gErrS').textContent = `You are signed in as ${me.user.email}, which does not have admin access. Sign in with an admin account.`;
  }catch(e){ /* not signed in */ }
  setTimeout(()=>{ const k = document.getElementById('gEmail'); if(k) k.focus(); }, 50);
})();
</script>
